Frequently Asked Questions: Social Media Marketing in the UAE

How much does social media marketing cost in Dubai?

Social media management packages in Dubai typically range from AED 3,000–15,000 per month depending on the number of platforms, posting frequency, whether paid advertising is included, and the level of content production required. Paid social advertising budgets are separate and typically range from AED 2,000–20,000+ per month. We offer transparent, tiered packages tailored to your business size and objectives. Contact us for a custom quote.

Which social media platform is best for UAE businesses?

It depends entirely on your industry and target audience. Instagram is essential for consumer-facing brands. LinkedIn dominates B2B. TikTok is critical for reaching under-35 audiences. Facebook remains valuable for expatriate communities and detailed ad targeting. Most UAE businesses benefit from a multi-platform strategy with at least two to three active channels.

How long does it take to see results from social media marketing?

Organic social media results typically become measurable within 60–90 days of implementing a consistent, strategic content programme. Paid social campaigns can deliver results within days. Building a genuinely loyal community and seeing significant commercial impact from social typically takes six to twelve months of consistent effort.

Do you create Arabic social media content?

Yes. Arabic-language and bilingual content creation is a core part of our UAE social media service. Our team includes native Arabic copywriters and Arabic-speaking designers who create content that resonates authentically with Arabic-speaking audiences — not generic machine translations.

Can you manage our social media and run paid ads simultaneously?

Absolutely. In fact, integrated organic and paid social strategies consistently outperform either approach in isolation. We manage both streams seamlessly, using organic content performance data to inform paid campaign creative and targeting decisions.

Do you work with influencers in the UAE?

Yes. We have established relationships with a curated network of UAE-based influencers across lifestyle, luxury, food, fitness, tech, finance, and more — ranging from nano influencers (10K–50K followers) to major macro influencers with millions of followers. We handle everything from identification and vetting to negotiation, briefing, and post-campaign analysis.

How do you handle Ramadan social media campaigns?

Ramadan requires significant advance planning. We typically begin developing Ramadan content strategies six to eight weeks before the Holy Month begins. This includes a dedicated content calendar, culturally appropriate creative direction, adjusted posting schedules aligned with Suhoor and Iftar times, and campaign messaging that balances commercial objectives with genuine cultural respect.

What makes your social media agency different from others in Dubai?

Three things: UAE-specific expertise (including Arabic content and cultural fluency), full integration with SEO and paid media for holistic digital growth, and transparent reporting that connects social performance directly to business outcomes. We do not offer generic packages — every strategy is built from scratch for your specific brand, audience, and objectives.

Do I need a large budget to get started?

No. We work with UAE businesses at various stages of growth, from funded startups to enterprise brands. Our entry-level social media management packages are designed to deliver real results even with modest budgets, focusing on the one or two platforms where your specific audience is most active and your content will have the greatest impact.

How do you measure social media ROI?

We measure ROI through a combination of platform analytics (reach, engagement, follower growth), website analytics (traffic from social, time on site, pages visited), and conversion tracking (leads, form fills, purchases, calls). For e-commerce clients, we track ROAS directly. Every monthly report translates metrics into clear business impact, not just vanity numbers.

Can you help us create a social media strategy if we already have an internal team?

Yes. We offer social media strategy consultancy and training for in-house teams that want to uplevel their approach. This includes audience research, content pillar development, platform-specific best practices, content calendar frameworks, and paid social training. Get in touch to discuss consultancy options.

Do you offer social media audits?

Yes — and we offer the first audit free. Our social media audit covers all active channels, content quality assessment, posting consistency, engagement benchmarking, competitor comparison, audience analysis, and a prioritised list of recommendations. Claim your free audit here.

  • SEO Services — Rank higher on Google and drive organic traffic that compounds over time
  • PPC Management — Paid search campaigns on Google and Bing that complement your social advertising
  • Web Design — Convert the social traffic you generate into leads and customers with a high-performing website
  • AI Search Optimisation — Ensure your brand appears in AI-powered search results and ChatGPT recommendations
  • All Digital Marketing Services — See our complete offering for UAE businesses

item.title: Web Design Services Dubai — Conversion-Optimised Websites
item.content:encoded:
Your website is your most important marketing asset. It's open 24/7. It's the first impression for every prospect who searches for your business online. It either converts visitors into enquiries, leads, and sales — or it silently loses them to a competitor. We design and build websites that do the former: visually distinctive, psychologically optimised for conversion, technically excellent, and built to rank in both traditional and AI-powered search.

We are not a template agency. Every website we design is bespoke — built from the ground up for your brand, your audience, and your specific conversion goals. Our process combines user psychology, data-driven design decisions, and meticulous visual craft to create digital experiences that are as effective as they are beautiful.

What Makes a Website Excellent in 2025?

The bar for website quality has never been higher. Users form opinions about your website within 50 milliseconds — before they've read a single word. Those opinions inform whether they stay, whether they trust you, and ultimately whether they enquire. At the same time, Google uses dozens of technical signals (Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, security, structured data) to determine how prominently to rank your site. And increasingly, AI search systems scan your site for content they can cite in AI-generated answers.

Excellent websites in 2025 need to perform across all three dimensions simultaneously: user experience that converts, technical performance that ranks, and content architecture that earns AI search visibility. This is precisely what we design for.

Our Web Design Services

Brand Identity and Visual Design

Before we design a website, we ensure the visual foundation is right. For clients without a strong existing brand identity, we develop (or refine) the core visual system: logo, colour palette, typography hierarchy, iconography style, and photography direction. Every visual decision is made intentionally — not aesthetically at random. Colour psychology, typography legibility at scale, and brand differentiation in your market all inform our choices.

UX Research and Information Architecture

Good design follows good research. Before any visual design begins, we develop a clear picture of your users — their motivations, their concerns, the questions they have at different stages of the buying journey, and the friction points that cause them to abandon. We then build an information architecture (page hierarchy, navigation structure, content flow) that serves those users efficiently and guides them toward conversion.

Information architecture decisions — which pages exist, how they're named, how they link to each other — have enormous SEO implications too. We design site architectures that distribute PageRank efficiently, create clear topical silos for search engines, and enable the internal linking structure required for strong organic performance.

Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) Design

A beautiful website that doesn't convert is a beautiful failure. Every design decision we make — layout, colour choices, CTA placement, form design, social proof positioning, headline hierarchy — is informed by conversion psychology. We use principles from behavioural economics, attention research, and A/B testing data accumulated across our client portfolio to design pages that guide visitors toward the action you want them to take.

Key CRO elements we design for: above-the-fold clarity (communicating what you do and why it matters within seconds), trust signal integration (reviews, certifications, client logos, media mentions), friction reduction in contact and enquiry forms, visual hierarchy that guides eye flow toward CTAs, and social proof placed at the points of maximum persuasive impact.

Responsive and Mobile-First Design

In the UAE, over 75% of web browsing happens on mobile devices. Google uses the mobile version of your site for indexing and ranking. A website that delivers a subpar mobile experience doesn't just frustrate users — it actively ranks lower in Google results. All websites we design are mobile-first: designed for the smallest screen first, then progressively enhanced for tablets and desktop.

Mobile-first design goes beyond making content fit on a smaller screen. It means rethinking tap targets (finger-sized, not click-sized), form interactions (minimised text input, appropriate keyboard types), page speed on mobile connections, and the content prioritisation appropriate for a mobile context — where users are often in discovery mode with less time and patience.

WordPress and CMS Design

We specialise in WordPress — the world's most popular CMS, powering over 43% of all websites. For our clients, WordPress means complete content control without needing a developer to update a headline or add a blog post. We design WordPress themes and implement page builder configurations (or bespoke theme builds for enterprise clients) that give your team complete editorial freedom while maintaining design integrity.

Our WordPress builds include full CMS training so your team can confidently manage content from day one. We also architect the WordPress implementation for SEO — clean URL structures, fast load times, proper heading hierarchy, schema markup integration, and optimised image delivery.

Landing Page Design

High-converting landing pages are specialist work. Whether you need landing pages for Google Ads campaigns, lead generation from social media, specific product launches, or event registrations, our landing page design service creates focused, distraction-free pages optimised for a single conversion goal. Landing pages designed specifically for campaigns consistently outperform homepages by 2–5x on conversion rate.

The SEO.ae Web Design Process

Our process eliminates the surprises and misalignments that make web design projects go over budget and miss deadlines. We use a structured, collaborative approach that keeps you informed and in control at every stage:

Discovery: Understanding your business, audience, competitors, and goals in depth. Reviewing analytics from your current site if available. Defining success metrics for the new site.

Strategy: Developing the site architecture, page hierarchy, conversion strategy, and content framework before any design begins.

Wireframing: Low-fidelity layout blueprints that establish the structure and content flow of every key page — without the distraction of visual design. Client approval at this stage prevents costly design revisions later.

Visual Design: Applying your brand identity to the approved wireframes, creating high-fidelity desktop and mobile mockups for all key pages. We design in Figma, enabling detailed stakeholder feedback directly on the design files.

Development: Building the approved designs into a fast, secure, accessible website. We write clean code, implement performance optimisations from day one, and rigorously test across browsers and devices.

Content Integration: Loading and formatting all final content, optimising images, implementing schema markup, configuring Yoast SEO, and performing pre-launch technical checks.

Launch and Handover: Controlled launch with pre/post monitoring, full CMS training for your team, and a documentation package covering how to manage every aspect of your new website.

Web Design for SEO: Why It Matters from Day One

Too many websites are designed beautifully, then handed to an SEO agency and discovered to be a technical nightmare — JavaScript-rendered content Google can't read, URL structures that create duplicate content, image-heavy designs that fail Core Web Vitals, and no clear site architecture for link authority distribution.

We eliminate this problem by designing for SEO from the first wireframe. Site architecture decisions, URL structure, heading hierarchy, internal linking patterns, image optimisation strategy, and Core Web Vitals performance are all addressed during the design and development process — not retrofitted afterward.

Common Web Design Mistakes UAE Businesses Make

  • Prioritising aesthetics over conversion: A stunning website that doesn't convert enquiries is a liability, not an asset. Design serves business goals.
  • Ignoring page speed: UAE users have high speed expectations. A site that takes more than 3 seconds to load will lose the majority of visitors — and rank lower in Google.
  • Underinvesting in mobile experience: With 75%+ of UAE browsing on mobile, a desktop-first design is designing for the minority.
  • Using sliders and carousels: Research consistently shows that carousels reduce conversion rate. Static, focused hero sections with a single strong message outperform carousels in virtually every test.
  • Burying the CTA: Visitors shouldn't have to scroll or search to find how to contact you. CTAs above the fold, in the navigation, and throughout the page significantly improve enquiry rates.
  • Choosing a cheap theme: Template-based sites look generic, perform poorly in search, and rarely reflect brand premium. For a business where website leads are significant, the ROI from a professionally designed site typically delivers in months.

Web Design Trends in Dubai 2025

Dubai's digital landscape is evolving at a pace that matches the city's ambition. The UAE has one of the highest smartphone penetration rates in the world — over 97% — and Emirati consumers are among the most digitally sophisticated audiences globally. If your website was designed even two or three years ago, it may already feel dated to your target audience. Here are the most significant web design trends reshaping business websites in Dubai and across the UAE in 2025.

AI-Generated and AI-Assisted Design

Artificial intelligence is transforming the design process — not by replacing designers, but by accelerating production and personalisation. AI tools now assist with generating initial visual concepts, suggesting colour palettes based on brand values, optimising layout for conversion, and even dynamically adapting content based on user behaviour. For Dubai businesses, this means faster design iterations, lower costs for revisions, and websites that learn and adapt to visitor patterns over time. Our AI search optimisation practice also informs how we structure content to be discovered by AI-powered search engines like Perplexity and ChatGPT.

Dark Mode and High-Contrast Interfaces

Dark mode is no longer a novelty — it's an expectation. Studies show that 82% of smartphone users prefer dark mode for evening browsing, and it significantly reduces eye strain on OLED displays that dominate the premium smartphone market. In Dubai, where luxury positioning is critical for many businesses, dark interfaces convey sophistication and exclusivity. We design websites with true dark mode support rather than a simple colour inversion — ensuring images, icons, and content all look intentional in both modes.

Micro-Animations and Motion Design

Subtle, purposeful animation communicates quality. Hover effects, loading transitions, scroll-triggered reveals, and interactive feedback all signal that your website is premium, modern, and attentive to detail. The key word is purposeful: animation should guide attention, confirm interactions, and delight users — not distract or slow down the experience. We implement micro-animations using CSS and lightweight JavaScript to keep performance uncompromised while elevating the visual quality.

Arabic RTL Design and Bilingual Architecture

Dubai's population is roughly 30% Arabic-speaking, and Arabic is the official language of the UAE. A truly localised website doesn't just translate text — it reflects on the entire layout and user experience for RTL (right-to-left) languages. Typography choices, navigation alignment, icon positioning, form field layouts, and even reading flow patterns all need to be reconsidered for Arabic audiences. We design bilingual websites with genuine RTL support from the outset, not bolted-on translations that feel awkward. This is not just good practice — it's often essential for government contracts, enterprise tenders, and reaching the substantial Arabic-speaking consumer market.

Performance-First Design Philosophy

Google's Core Web Vitals are now significant ranking signals, and users in Dubai expect near-instant load times on mobile 5G connections. We design with performance as a constraint from day one: optimised images, minimal render-blocking resources, critical CSS inlining, and efficient font loading. Our designs consistently achieve 90+ scores on Google PageSpeed Insights — which matters both for SEO rankings and for the user experience that drives conversions.

The Anatomy of a High-Converting UAE Website

Not all beautiful websites convert visitors into customers. Conversion is a function of clarity, trust, relevance, and ease — and achieving all four requires intentional design decisions across every element of the page. Here is our evidence-based checklist for websites that generate enquiries, leads, and sales in the UAE market.

✅ High-Converting UAE Website Checklist

  • Above-the-fold clarity: Within 3 seconds, visitors know exactly what you do, who you serve, and what to do next
  • Mobile-first layout: Optimised for the 78% of UAE users who browse primarily on mobile devices
  • Trust signals prominently placed: Client logos, testimonials, certifications, years in business, and real team photos
  • Clear value proposition: What makes you different from the 50 other companies offering the same service in Dubai?
  • Frictionless primary CTA: One clear next step — phone number, WhatsApp link, or short enquiry form — visible without scrolling
  • WhatsApp integration: UAE consumers expect instant messaging; WhatsApp click-to-chat is non-negotiable for B2C and many B2B audiences
  • Social proof throughout: Not just one testimonials page — evidence of trust interspersed throughout every key page
  • Arabic language option: Even if your primary audience is English-speaking, offering Arabic signals respect for local culture
  • Fast load times: Under 2.5 seconds on mobile (LCP metric) — users will abandon faster-loading alternatives
  • SSL and security indicators: HTTPS padlock, privacy policy, and data protection clarity — especially important post-UAE PDPL
  • Structured content for SEO: Proper H1-H6 hierarchy, schema markup, and internally linked content strategy
  • Clear service pages: Each service has its own dedicated page with full detail — not a single overview page for everything
  • Location-specific signals: Dubai address, UAE phone number, local landmarks or references that build geographic trust
  • Analytics and conversion tracking: GA4 goals, call tracking, and form submission events configured from launch

Every website we design at SearchEngineOptimization.ae is built against this checklist. We don't ship websites that haven't been reviewed for each of these conversion fundamentals. Our web development team ensures the technical implementation matches the design intent precisely.

Web Design Pricing in Dubai

One of the most common questions we receive is: "How much does a website cost in Dubai?" The honest answer is that it depends — significantly — on the scope, complexity, and strategic ambition of the project. What follows is a transparent breakdown of realistic pricing for different tiers of website projects in the UAE market.

Project Type Budget Range (AED) Typical Timeline Best For
SME Business Website AED 5,000 – 15,000 4–8 weeks Startups, SMEs, service businesses needing a professional online presence
Professional Services Site AED 15,000 – 30,000 6–10 weeks Law firms, consultancies, medical practices, real estate agencies
E-Commerce Store AED 15,000 – 40,000 8–14 weeks Online retailers, product brands, D2C businesses in UAE
Enterprise / Corporate AED 30,000 – 80,000+ 12–20 weeks Large enterprises, multi-brand sites, complex integrations, bilingual architecture
Custom Web Application AED 50,000 – 200,000+ 16–32 weeks SaaS products, portals, booking platforms, marketplace websites

What's included in our web design projects? Discovery and strategy workshop, sitemap and wireframing, full visual design (desktop and mobile), design review rounds, handoff to development, and post-launch support. We never charge hidden fees for responsive design — it's built in from day one. For full transparency on what's right for your project, book a free consultation and we'll provide a detailed scope and quote.

A note on cheap website builders: DIY website platforms like Wix, Squarespace, and GoDaddy offer websites from AED 100/month. For a business serious about growth in Dubai's competitive market, these platforms have critical limitations: restricted SEO customisation, slow page speeds, template-dependent design, and no real differentiation from competitors. The cost of a professional website is typically recovered within months through improved conversion rates and organic search visibility.

Common Web Design Mistakes That Cost Dubai Businesses

After working with hundreds of businesses across the UAE, we've identified the most expensive and most common web design mistakes. If your current website is underperforming, the cause is almost certainly one (or more) of these issues.

1. Designing for Desktop First

In the UAE, 78% of web traffic comes from mobile devices. Yet many agencies still design desktop-first and then adapt for mobile as an afterthought. The result is a mobile experience that feels squeezed, buttons that are too small to tap, and text that requires zooming. We design mobile-first and then scale up to desktop — the opposite approach.

2. Ignoring Page Speed

A website that takes more than 3 seconds to load loses approximately 40% of visitors before they've seen anything. This is especially damaging for paid search campaigns, where you're paying for clicks that bounce immediately. Core Web Vitals failures also directly suppress your rankings on Google. Speed is not a technical afterthought — it is a business-critical design decision.

3. Too Many Calls to Action

Paradox of choice applies to websites: when visitors are given too many options, they choose none. We see websites with ten different CTA buttons above the fold — "Call us," "Email us," "Download brochure," "Watch video," "Book demo," "View pricing." Choose one primary action per page and make that action impossible to miss.

4. Weak or Generic Copywriting

Design attracts attention; copy closes sales. Many beautiful websites fail because the words are corporate filler ("We are a leading provider of innovative solutions...") rather than clear, specific, compelling reasons to choose this business over competitors. Great web design and great copy must work together. This is why our process includes messaging strategy before visual design begins.

5. No Arabic Language Support

Dubai's population is 30% Arabic-speaking, and Arabic language capability signals that your business is genuinely invested in the local market. Businesses without Arabic websites are effectively excluding a significant portion of their potential audience — particularly in consumer-facing sectors like retail, hospitality, real estate, and healthcare.

6. Stock Photography That Undermines Trust

Overused stock photos (especially smiling people in generic office settings) are immediately recognisable and damage trust. Real photos of your team, your office, your work, and your clients build the authenticity that converts. For businesses concerned about professional photography costs, even high-quality phone photography is better than tired stock images.

7. Not Designing for AI Search

AI-powered search tools like Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT are increasingly the first touchpoint in the customer journey. Websites that don't structure their content for AI citation — with clear, well-organised, factual, and authoritative content — are invisible to this growing traffic channel. Our AI search optimisation service specifically addresses this gap.

8. Launching Without Analytics Setup

A shockingly large number of websites go live without proper Google Analytics 4 configuration, conversion goal tracking, or event tracking. Without data, you have no idea what's working, where users are dropping off, or which pages are generating leads. We configure full analytics and conversion tracking as part of every website project — before launch, not as an afterthought.

Key Takeaways

🔑 What to Remember About Web Design in Dubai

  • Users form opinions about your website in 50 milliseconds — first impressions are overwhelmingly visual
  • 78% of UAE web traffic comes from mobile devices — mobile-first design is essential, not optional
  • Bilingual Arabic/English design is a competitive differentiator in the UAE market
  • Core Web Vitals (speed and performance metrics) directly impact Google search rankings
  • Professional business websites in Dubai range from AED 5,000 to AED 80,000+ depending on scope
  • The biggest conversion mistake is too many calls to action — one clear next step outperforms ten options
  • WhatsApp integration is non-negotiable for UAE B2C and many B2B websites
  • AI search visibility requires structured, authoritative content — not just visual design
  • Analytics and conversion tracking must be configured before launch, not added later

Frequently Asked Questions: Web Design in Dubai

How long does it take to design and build a website in Dubai?

A typical SME business website takes 4–8 weeks from project kick-off to launch. This includes the discovery phase, sitemap and wireframe approval, visual design rounds, development, content population, testing, and launch preparation. Larger enterprise projects or complex e-commerce builds typically take 12–20 weeks. Timelines depend significantly on how quickly clients can provide feedback, content, and approvals — client responsiveness is often the primary factor in project duration. If you have a specific deadline, contact us early so we can plan accordingly.

Which platforms do you build websites on?

Our primary platform is WordPress, which powers approximately 43% of all websites globally and is the most flexible and widely supported CMS available. For e-commerce, we build on WooCommerce (WordPress-based). For high-performance front-end requirements, we use Next.js as a headless CMS front-end. We evaluate the right platform for each project based on the client's content management needs, integration requirements, budget, and long-term maintenance considerations. We do not build on closed-platform builders like Wix or Squarespace for business clients due to their SEO and performance limitations.

Will my website be mobile-responsive?

Yes — without exception. Every website we design is built mobile-first, meaning the mobile experience is the primary design consideration, with desktop versions adapting upward. This reflects the reality that 78% of web traffic in the UAE comes from mobile devices. We test across multiple device types, screen sizes, and browsers before any website goes live.

Can you build websites in Arabic and English?

Yes. We have experience designing and developing bilingual Arabic/English websites with proper RTL (right-to-left) layout support for Arabic. This is not a simple translation overlay — it involves genuinely redesigning navigation, layout, and typography for the Arabic reading experience. We work with professional translation services for Arabic content, or we can work with content provided by the client.

Will my website rank on Google?

We design and develop every website with SEO as a foundational consideration — not an afterthought. This includes proper URL structure, clean semantic HTML, schema markup, fast load speeds, and mobile usability. However, ranking on Google also requires ongoing SEO content and link-building work after launch. A well-built website is the essential foundation; ongoing SEO builds on that foundation to drive rankings and traffic. We offer integrated SEO services that work alongside our web design projects.

Do you offer website maintenance after launch?

Yes. We offer monthly maintenance plans that include WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates; security monitoring and malware scanning; uptime monitoring; performance checks; and a set number of minor content update hours each month. We strongly recommend ongoing maintenance for any business-critical website — outdated WordPress installations are the most common cause of website security breaches.

How much does a website cost in Dubai?

Professional business websites in Dubai typically range from AED 5,000–15,000 for SME projects to AED 30,000–80,000+ for enterprise-grade sites. E-commerce websites generally range from AED 15,000–40,000 depending on complexity. These prices reflect bespoke design and development — not template-based work. We provide fixed-price project proposals after a discovery call so there are no surprises. Request a quote here.

Can you redesign my existing website without losing my SEO?

Yes — and this is critically important. A website redesign done incorrectly can destroy years of SEO work overnight. We implement a full SEO preservation protocol on every redesign: comprehensive URL mapping and 301 redirect implementation, preservation of existing meta data, crawl testing before and after launch, Google Search Console monitoring during and after launch, and structured data preservation. We've rescued several businesses whose previous redesign had caused 60–80% traffic drops.

Do you design e-commerce websites?

Yes. We design and build e-commerce websites on WooCommerce (for WordPress) and can integrate with UAE payment gateways including Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, and Amazon Payment Services. Our e-commerce design focuses heavily on conversion rate optimisation — reducing friction at every stage of the purchase journey. We also connect e-commerce platforms to UAE logistics providers, inventory systems, and CRMs as required.

Can you connect my website to third-party tools like CRM, email marketing, or booking systems?

Yes. Modern business websites rarely exist in isolation — they need to integrate with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho), email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo), booking systems, live chat tools, WhatsApp Business API, and often ERP or inventory systems. We handle all of these integrations as part of our web development service, with full testing and documentation.

What is your web design process?

Our process has five phases: (1) Discovery — we understand your business, audience, competitors, and goals; (2) Strategy — sitemap, user journey mapping, and content planning; (3) Design — wireframes, then full visual design with 2 rounds of revisions included; (4) Development — pixel-perfect build with full testing; (5) Launch and handover — analytics setup, training, and go-live support. We provide a dedicated project manager for every project so you always have a single point of contact.

Do you provide website copywriting?

Yes — as an optional add-on. We strongly recommend professional copywriting for business websites because the words are ultimately what convert visitors into customers. Our copywriting service includes messaging strategy, SEO keyword integration, and professional English copywriting. For Arabic content, we work with specialist UAE-based Arabic copywriters. Poor copy is one of the most common reasons a well-designed website fails to generate enquiries.

How do you ensure my website is secure?

Security is built into our development process, not bolted on afterwards. For WordPress sites: we use only reputable, actively maintained plugins; implement file permission hardening; set up a Web Application Firewall (WAF); configure regular automated backups (stored offsite); install SSL certificates; and restrict login access by IP where appropriate. We also recommend and configure ongoing security monitoring as part of our maintenance plans.

Can I update my website myself after it's built?

Absolutely — this is a core goal of every website we build. We use WordPress because it has the most intuitive content management system available. We configure the CMS specifically for each client, so the editing experience is as simple as possible. We also provide training sessions (recorded for future reference) for every project handover. You should be able to update text, images, blog posts, and service pages without any developer involvement.

How do I get started with a web design project?

The first step is a free discovery consultation — typically 45–60 minutes — where we discuss your business, goals, current website challenges, and initial budget range. Following that, we'll provide a detailed proposal with scope, timeline, and fixed price. There's no obligation and no hard sell. Book your free consultation here, or browse our case studies to see examples of our work first.

Related Services

A great website is the foundation — but it's what happens after launch that determines your return on investment. Our integrated services ensure your website doesn't just look excellent, but consistently generates traffic, leads, and revenue.

  • Web Development — Custom WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js development with enterprise-grade code quality
  • SEO Services — On-page, technical, and content SEO to drive organic traffic to your new website
  • AI Search Optimisation — Optimise your content for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT visibility
  • PPC Management — Google Ads and paid search campaigns that maximise your new website's conversion potential
  • Social Media Marketing — Extend your brand's digital presence beyond your website

Ready for a Website That Actually Converts?

Book a free 45-minute consultation. We'll review your current website, identify the biggest conversion and SEO opportunities, and outline exactly what a new site could achieve for your business.

Get Your Free Website Audit View Our Work

Not sure where to start? Browse our digital marketing blog for free expert guides on web design best practices, Dubai SEO strategy, and digital marketing in the UAE. Or explore our full range of digital marketing services to see how web design fits into a complete growth strategy. Learn more about our team and approach on our about page.

Convert visitors into customers with high-performance, SEO-ready websites that combine world-class design with measurable business results — built specifically for the UAE market and global standards.
Bespoke designs built to reflect your brand identity and Dubai market positioning
Mobile-first approach designed for the 85%+ of UAE users browsing on smartphone
Arabic and English bilingual layouts with proper RTL support and cultural adaptation
Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) built into every page layout and element
Core Web Vitals optimisation ensuring fast, smooth page experience from launch
SEO-ready architecture with clean code, semantic HTML, and schema markup
CMS-powered design — edit any page, any time through a simple admin dashboard
Brand identity and visual language creation for new businesses
Landing page design optimised for PPC campaigns and paid media performance
Post-launch A/B testing to continuously improve conversion rates over time

We run a structured discovery session to understand your business goals, target UAE audience, competitive positioning, brand values, and the specific actions you want website visitors to take. This shapes every design decision.

Before design, we map the optimal user journey through your site — from arrival to conversion. Wireframes define the information architecture, page layouts, and conversion pathways before any visual element is added.

Our designers create a bespoke visual design that expresses your brand personality, appeals to your target UAE audience, and differentiates you from competitors. You receive a complete design system including colours, typography, and component library.

We build interactive Figma prototypes of all key pages so you can experience the design before a single line of code is written. Multiple revision rounds ensure the final design is exactly right before development begins.
Designs are built with clean semantic HTML/CSS, responsive across all devices, and integrated with WordPress CMS that gives your team full control to update content without developer assistance.

Rigorous testing across devices, browsers, screen sizes, and connection speeds. Every link, form, animation, and interactive element is checked before launch. Go-live is coordinated to minimise any SEO ranking impact.

Website launch is the beginning, not the end. We monitor Core Web Vitals, heatmaps, session recordings, and conversion data post-launch to identify optimisation opportunities and continuously improve performance.
How much does a website cost in Dubai?

Professional business website design in Dubai ranges from AED 5,000–15,000 for a standard SME site to AED 20,000–80,000+ for complex enterprise or ecommerce projects. Cost depends on page count, design complexity, custom functionality, CMS integration, and Arabic language support. We provide detailed, itemised proposals after a free consultation — no hidden costs or surprise invoices.
How long does it take to design and build a website in Dubai?

A standard business website (5–15 pages) typically takes 6–10 weeks from project kick-off to launch. This includes discovery (1 week), wireframing (1 week), visual design (2 weeks), development (2–3 weeks), content integration and QA (1–2 weeks). Ecommerce websites and complex custom builds may take 12–20 weeks. The timeline depends heavily on content readiness — clients who have their content prepared benefit from significantly faster delivery.
Do you design Arabic websites with RTL support?

Yes. Bilingual Arabic-English websites are a core speciality. Arabic web design requires genuine RTL layout implementation — not simply mirroring an English design. We design Arabic layouts natively, select appropriate Arabic typefaces, adapt visual compositions for Arabic reading patterns, and ensure the CMS allows editors to manage Arabic and English content independently.
What is a conversion-optimised website and why does it matter?

A conversion-optimised website is designed with the primary goal of turning visitors into enquiries, leads, or sales. This means: clear value propositions above the fold, strategic CTA placement, trust signals (testimonials, certifications) at key decision points, frictionless contact forms, fast loading speeds, and mobile usability that matches how UAE users actually browse. A conversion-optimised website can double or triple the leads generated from the same amount of traffic.
What is Core Web Vitals and why is it important for my Dubai website?

Core Web Vitals are Google's user experience metrics measuring Largest Contentful Paint (loading speed), Interaction to Next Paint (responsiveness), and Cumulative Layout Shift (visual stability). These are direct Google ranking factors — poor scores directly reduce your organic search rankings. In the UAE mobile-first market, Core Web Vitals also directly impact bounce rates and conversion rates. All our websites pass Core Web Vitals thresholds from day one.
Will my website be easy to update without a developer?

Absolutely. Every website we build runs on WordPress CMS that gives your team complete control to update text, images, blog posts, team pages, service descriptions, and more through a simple visual interface — no coding required. We provide a personalised training session covering all updates your team will need, plus written documentation. For clients who prefer not to manage updates, we offer monthly maintenance packages.
Is my website built to rank on Google from the start?

Yes. SEO-readiness is built into every project from the architecture stage. This includes: clean semantic HTML, proper heading hierarchy, optimised page titles and meta descriptions, XML sitemap and robots.txt configuration, schema markup implementation, compressed WebP-format images with descriptive alt text, canonical tags, and structured internal linking. We also integrate our SEO service with new web builds for immediate ranking momentum.
Do you design landing pages for Google Ads campaigns?

Yes. Conversion-focused landing pages are among our most valuable deliverables. A purpose-built landing page — with a single clear offer, compelling headline, trust signals, and frictionless form — can double or triple conversion rates versus sending PPC traffic to a standard website page. We build, test, and continuously optimise landing pages to maximise advertising ROI.
What happens after my website launches?

We provide 30 days of post-launch support at no charge — fixing any bugs, addressing browser compatibility issues, and making minor content adjustments. After 30 days, ongoing support is available through maintenance packages covering security updates, WordPress/plugin updates, performance monitoring, and monthly content updates.
Can you redesign my existing website while keeping my SEO rankings?

Yes. SEO preservation during redesign is something we take extremely seriously. A poorly managed migration can cause significant ranking drops. Our process includes a comprehensive URL audit and redirect mapping before any changes, preserving all existing ranking URLs with 301 redirects, migrating all meta data, and monitoring rankings closely for 3 months post-launch. Contact us for a migration audit before committing to any redesign.

Your website is your most important marketing asset. It's open 24/7. It's the first impression for every prospect who searches for your business online. It either converts visitors into enquiries, leads, and sales — or it silently loses them to a competitor. We design and build websites that do the former: visually distinctive, psychologically optimised for conversion, technically excellent, and built to rank in both traditional and AI-powered search.

We are not a template agency. Every website we design is bespoke — built from the ground up for your brand, your audience, and your specific conversion goals. Our process combines user psychology, data-driven design decisions, and meticulous visual craft to create digital experiences that are as effective as they are beautiful.

What Makes a Website Excellent in 2025?

The bar for website quality has never been higher. Users form opinions about your website within 50 milliseconds — before they've read a single word. Those opinions inform whether they stay, whether they trust you, and ultimately whether they enquire. At the same time, Google uses dozens of technical signals (Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, security, structured data) to determine how prominently to rank your site. And increasingly, AI search systems scan your site for content they can cite in AI-generated answers.

Excellent websites in 2025 need to perform across all three dimensions simultaneously: user experience that converts, technical performance that ranks, and content architecture that earns AI search visibility. This is precisely what we design for.

Our Web Design Services

Brand Identity and Visual Design

Before we design a website, we ensure the visual foundation is right. For clients without a strong existing brand identity, we develop (or refine) the core visual system: logo, colour palette, typography hierarchy, iconography style, and photography direction. Every visual decision is made intentionally — not aesthetically at random. Colour psychology, typography legibility at scale, and brand differentiation in your market all inform our choices.

UX Research and Information Architecture

Good design follows good research. Before any visual design begins, we develop a clear picture of your users — their motivations, their concerns, the questions they have at different stages of the buying journey, and the friction points that cause them to abandon. We then build an information architecture (page hierarchy, navigation structure, content flow) that serves those users efficiently and guides them toward conversion.

Information architecture decisions — which pages exist, how they're named, how they link to each other — have enormous SEO implications too. We design site architectures that distribute PageRank efficiently, create clear topical silos for search engines, and enable the internal linking structure required for strong organic performance.

Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) Design

A beautiful website that doesn't convert is a beautiful failure. Every design decision we make — layout, colour choices, CTA placement, form design, social proof positioning, headline hierarchy — is informed by conversion psychology. We use principles from behavioural economics, attention research, and A/B testing data accumulated across our client portfolio to design pages that guide visitors toward the action you want them to take.

Key CRO elements we design for: above-the-fold clarity (communicating what you do and why it matters within seconds), trust signal integration (reviews, certifications, client logos, media mentions), friction reduction in contact and enquiry forms, visual hierarchy that guides eye flow toward CTAs, and social proof placed at the points of maximum persuasive impact.

Responsive and Mobile-First Design

In the UAE, over 75% of web browsing happens on mobile devices. Google uses the mobile version of your site for indexing and ranking. A website that delivers a subpar mobile experience doesn't just frustrate users — it actively ranks lower in Google results. All websites we design are mobile-first: designed for the smallest screen first, then progressively enhanced for tablets and desktop.

Mobile-first design goes beyond making content fit on a smaller screen. It means rethinking tap targets (finger-sized, not click-sized), form interactions (minimised text input, appropriate keyboard types), page speed on mobile connections, and the content prioritisation appropriate for a mobile context — where users are often in discovery mode with less time and patience.

WordPress and CMS Design

We specialise in WordPress — the world's most popular CMS, powering over 43% of all websites. For our clients, WordPress means complete content control without needing a developer to update a headline or add a blog post. We design WordPress themes and implement page builder configurations (or bespoke theme builds for enterprise clients) that give your team complete editorial freedom while maintaining design integrity.

Our WordPress builds include full CMS training so your team can confidently manage content from day one. We also architect the WordPress implementation for SEO — clean URL structures, fast load times, proper heading hierarchy, schema markup integration, and optimised image delivery.

Landing Page Design

High-converting landing pages are specialist work. Whether you need landing pages for Google Ads campaigns, lead generation from social media, specific product launches, or event registrations, our landing page design service creates focused, distraction-free pages optimised for a single conversion goal. Landing pages designed specifically for campaigns consistently outperform homepages by 2–5x on conversion rate.

The SEO.ae Web Design Process

Our process eliminates the surprises and misalignments that make web design projects go over budget and miss deadlines. We use a structured, collaborative approach that keeps you informed and in control at every stage:

Discovery: Understanding your business, audience, competitors, and goals in depth. Reviewing analytics from your current site if available. Defining success metrics for the new site.

Strategy: Developing the site architecture, page hierarchy, conversion strategy, and content framework before any design begins.

Wireframing: Low-fidelity layout blueprints that establish the structure and content flow of every key page — without the distraction of visual design. Client approval at this stage prevents costly design revisions later.

Visual Design: Applying your brand identity to the approved wireframes, creating high-fidelity desktop and mobile mockups for all key pages. We design in Figma, enabling detailed stakeholder feedback directly on the design files.

Development: Building the approved designs into a fast, secure, accessible website. We write clean code, implement performance optimisations from day one, and rigorously test across browsers and devices.

Content Integration: Loading and formatting all final content, optimising images, implementing schema markup, configuring Yoast SEO, and performing pre-launch technical checks.

Launch and Handover: Controlled launch with pre/post monitoring, full CMS training for your team, and a documentation package covering how to manage every aspect of your new website.

Web Design for SEO: Why It Matters from Day One

Too many websites are designed beautifully, then handed to an SEO agency and discovered to be a technical nightmare — JavaScript-rendered content Google can't read, URL structures that create duplicate content, image-heavy designs that fail Core Web Vitals, and no clear site architecture for link authority distribution.

We eliminate this problem by designing for SEO from the first wireframe. Site architecture decisions, URL structure, heading hierarchy, internal linking patterns, image optimisation strategy, and Core Web Vitals performance are all addressed during the design and development process — not retrofitted afterward.

Common Web Design Mistakes UAE Businesses Make

  • Prioritising aesthetics over conversion: A stunning website that doesn't convert enquiries is a liability, not an asset. Design serves business goals.
  • Ignoring page speed: UAE users have high speed expectations. A site that takes more than 3 seconds to load will lose the majority of visitors — and rank lower in Google.
  • Underinvesting in mobile experience: With 75%+ of UAE browsing on mobile, a desktop-first design is designing for the minority.
  • Using sliders and carousels: Research consistently shows that carousels reduce conversion rate. Static, focused hero sections with a single strong message outperform carousels in virtually every test.
  • Burying the CTA: Visitors shouldn't have to scroll or search to find how to contact you. CTAs above the fold, in the navigation, and throughout the page significantly improve enquiry rates.
  • Choosing a cheap theme: Template-based sites look generic, perform poorly in search, and rarely reflect brand premium. For a business where website leads are significant, the ROI from a professionally designed site typically delivers in months.

Web Design Trends in Dubai 2025

Dubai's digital landscape is evolving at a pace that matches the city's ambition. The UAE has one of the highest smartphone penetration rates in the world — over 97% — and Emirati consumers are among the most digitally sophisticated audiences globally. If your website was designed even two or three years ago, it may already feel dated to your target audience. Here are the most significant web design trends reshaping business websites in Dubai and across the UAE in 2025.

AI-Generated and AI-Assisted Design

Artificial intelligence is transforming the design process — not by replacing designers, but by accelerating production and personalisation. AI tools now assist with generating initial visual concepts, suggesting colour palettes based on brand values, optimising layout for conversion, and even dynamically adapting content based on user behaviour. For Dubai businesses, this means faster design iterations, lower costs for revisions, and websites that learn and adapt to visitor patterns over time. Our AI search optimisation practice also informs how we structure content to be discovered by AI-powered search engines like Perplexity and ChatGPT.

Dark Mode and High-Contrast Interfaces

Dark mode is no longer a novelty — it's an expectation. Studies show that 82% of smartphone users prefer dark mode for evening browsing, and it significantly reduces eye strain on OLED displays that dominate the premium smartphone market. In Dubai, where luxury positioning is critical for many businesses, dark interfaces convey sophistication and exclusivity. We design websites with true dark mode support rather than a simple colour inversion — ensuring images, icons, and content all look intentional in both modes.

Micro-Animations and Motion Design

Subtle, purposeful animation communicates quality. Hover effects, loading transitions, scroll-triggered reveals, and interactive feedback all signal that your website is premium, modern, and attentive to detail. The key word is purposeful: animation should guide attention, confirm interactions, and delight users — not distract or slow down the experience. We implement micro-animations using CSS and lightweight JavaScript to keep performance uncompromised while elevating the visual quality.

Arabic RTL Design and Bilingual Architecture

Dubai's population is roughly 30% Arabic-speaking, and Arabic is the official language of the UAE. A truly localised website doesn't just translate text — it reflects on the entire layout and user experience for RTL (right-to-left) languages. Typography choices, navigation alignment, icon positioning, form field layouts, and even reading flow patterns all need to be reconsidered for Arabic audiences. We design bilingual websites with genuine RTL support from the outset, not bolted-on translations that feel awkward. This is not just good practice — it's often essential for government contracts, enterprise tenders, and reaching the substantial Arabic-speaking consumer market.

Performance-First Design Philosophy

Google's Core Web Vitals are now significant ranking signals, and users in Dubai expect near-instant load times on mobile 5G connections. We design with performance as a constraint from day one: optimised images, minimal render-blocking resources, critical CSS inlining, and efficient font loading. Our designs consistently achieve 90+ scores on Google PageSpeed Insights — which matters both for SEO rankings and for the user experience that drives conversions.

The Anatomy of a High-Converting UAE Website

Not all beautiful websites convert visitors into customers. Conversion is a function of clarity, trust, relevance, and ease — and achieving all four requires intentional design decisions across every element of the page. Here is our evidence-based checklist for websites that generate enquiries, leads, and sales in the UAE market.

✅ High-Converting UAE Website Checklist

  • Above-the-fold clarity: Within 3 seconds, visitors know exactly what you do, who you serve, and what to do next
  • Mobile-first layout: Optimised for the 78% of UAE users who browse primarily on mobile devices
  • Trust signals prominently placed: Client logos, testimonials, certifications, years in business, and real team photos
  • Clear value proposition: What makes you different from the 50 other companies offering the same service in Dubai?
  • Frictionless primary CTA: One clear next step — phone number, WhatsApp link, or short enquiry form — visible without scrolling
  • WhatsApp integration: UAE consumers expect instant messaging; WhatsApp click-to-chat is non-negotiable for B2C and many B2B audiences
  • Social proof throughout: Not just one testimonials page — evidence of trust interspersed throughout every key page
  • Arabic language option: Even if your primary audience is English-speaking, offering Arabic signals respect for local culture
  • Fast load times: Under 2.5 seconds on mobile (LCP metric) — users will abandon faster-loading alternatives
  • SSL and security indicators: HTTPS padlock, privacy policy, and data protection clarity — especially important post-UAE PDPL
  • Structured content for SEO: Proper H1-H6 hierarchy, schema markup, and internally linked content strategy
  • Clear service pages: Each service has its own dedicated page with full detail — not a single overview page for everything
  • Location-specific signals: Dubai address, UAE phone number, local landmarks or references that build geographic trust
  • Analytics and conversion tracking: GA4 goals, call tracking, and form submission events configured from launch

Every website we design at SearchEngineOptimization.ae is built against this checklist. We don't ship websites that haven't been reviewed for each of these conversion fundamentals. Our web development team ensures the technical implementation matches the design intent precisely.

Common Web Design Mistakes That Cost Dubai Businesses

After working with hundreds of businesses across the UAE, we've identified the most expensive and most common web design mistakes. If your current website is underperforming, the cause is almost certainly one (or more) of these issues.

1. Designing for Desktop First

In the UAE, 78% of web traffic comes from mobile devices. Yet many agencies still design desktop-first and then adapt for mobile as an afterthought. The result is a mobile experience that feels squeezed, buttons that are too small to tap, and text that requires zooming. We design mobile-first and then scale up to desktop — the opposite approach.

2. Ignoring Page Speed

A website that takes more than 3 seconds to load loses approximately 40% of visitors before they've seen anything. This is especially damaging for paid search campaigns, where you're paying for clicks that bounce immediately. Core Web Vitals failures also directly suppress your rankings on Google. Speed is not a technical afterthought — it is a business-critical design decision.

3. Too Many Calls to Action

Paradox of choice applies to websites: when visitors are given too many options, they choose none. We see websites with ten different CTA buttons above the fold — "Call us," "Email us," "Download brochure," "Watch video," "Book demo," "View pricing." Choose one primary action per page and make that action impossible to miss.

4. Weak or Generic Copywriting

Design attracts attention; copy closes sales. Many beautiful websites fail because the words are corporate filler ("We are a leading provider of innovative solutions...") rather than clear, specific, compelling reasons to choose this business over competitors. Great web design and great copy must work together. This is why our process includes messaging strategy before visual design begins.

5. No Arabic Language Support

Dubai's population is 30% Arabic-speaking, and Arabic language capability signals that your business is genuinely invested in the local market. Businesses without Arabic websites are effectively excluding a significant portion of their potential audience — particularly in consumer-facing sectors like retail, hospitality, real estate, and healthcare.

6. Stock Photography That Undermines Trust

Overused stock photos (especially smiling people in generic office settings) are immediately recognisable and damage trust. Real photos of your team, your office, your work, and your clients build the authenticity that converts. For businesses concerned about professional photography costs, even high-quality phone photography is better than tired stock images.

7. Not Designing for AI Search

AI-powered search tools like Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT are increasingly the first touchpoint in the customer journey. Websites that don't structure their content for AI citation — with clear, well-organised, factual, and authoritative content — are invisible to this growing traffic channel. Our AI search optimisation service specifically addresses this gap.

8. Launching Without Analytics Setup

A shockingly large number of websites go live without proper Google Analytics 4 configuration, conversion goal tracking, or event tracking. Without data, you have no idea what's working, where users are dropping off, or which pages are generating leads. We configure full analytics and conversion tracking as part of every website project — before launch, not as an afterthought.

Frequently Asked Questions: Web Design in Dubai

How long does it take to design and build a website in Dubai?

A typical SME business website takes 4–8 weeks from project kick-off to launch. This includes the discovery phase, sitemap and wireframe approval, visual design rounds, development, content population, testing, and launch preparation. Larger enterprise projects or complex e-commerce builds typically take 12–20 weeks. Timelines depend significantly on how quickly clients can provide feedback, content, and approvals — client responsiveness is often the primary factor in project duration. If you have a specific deadline, contact us early so we can plan accordingly.

Which platforms do you build websites on?

Our primary platform is WordPress, which powers approximately 43% of all websites globally and is the most flexible and widely supported CMS available. For e-commerce, we build on WooCommerce (WordPress-based). For high-performance front-end requirements, we use Next.js as a headless CMS front-end. We evaluate the right platform for each project based on the client's content management needs, integration requirements, budget, and long-term maintenance considerations. We do not build on closed-platform builders like Wix or Squarespace for business clients due to their SEO and performance limitations.

Will my website be mobile-responsive?

Yes — without exception. Every website we design is built mobile-first, meaning the mobile experience is the primary design consideration, with desktop versions adapting upward. This reflects the reality that 78% of web traffic in the UAE comes from mobile devices. We test across multiple device types, screen sizes, and browsers before any website goes live.

Can you build websites in Arabic and English?

Yes. We have experience designing and developing bilingual Arabic/English websites with proper RTL (right-to-left) layout support for Arabic. This is not a simple translation overlay — it involves genuinely redesigning navigation, layout, and typography for the Arabic reading experience. We work with professional translation services for Arabic content, or we can work with content provided by the client.

Will my website rank on Google?

We design and develop every website with SEO as a foundational consideration — not an afterthought. This includes proper URL structure, clean semantic HTML, schema markup, fast load speeds, and mobile usability. However, ranking on Google also requires ongoing SEO content and link-building work after launch. A well-built website is the essential foundation; ongoing SEO builds on that foundation to drive rankings and traffic. We offer integrated SEO services that work alongside our web design projects.

Do you offer website maintenance after launch?

Yes. We offer monthly maintenance plans that include WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates; security monitoring and malware scanning; uptime monitoring; performance checks; and a set number of minor content update hours each month. We strongly recommend ongoing maintenance for any business-critical website — outdated WordPress installations are the most common cause of website security breaches.

How much does a website cost in Dubai?

Professional business websites in Dubai typically range from AED 5,000–15,000 for SME projects to AED 30,000–80,000+ for enterprise-grade sites. E-commerce websites generally range from AED 15,000–40,000 depending on complexity. These prices reflect bespoke design and development — not template-based work. We provide fixed-price project proposals after a discovery call so there are no surprises. Request a quote here.

Can you redesign my existing website without losing my SEO?

Yes — and this is critically important. A website redesign done incorrectly can destroy years of SEO work overnight. We implement a full SEO preservation protocol on every redesign: comprehensive URL mapping and 301 redirect implementation, preservation of existing meta data, crawl testing before and after launch, Google Search Console monitoring during and after launch, and structured data preservation. We've rescued several businesses whose previous redesign had caused 60–80% traffic drops.

Do you design e-commerce websites?

Yes. We design and build e-commerce websites on WooCommerce (for WordPress) and can integrate with UAE payment gateways including Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, and Amazon Payment Services. Our e-commerce design focuses heavily on conversion rate optimisation — reducing friction at every stage of the purchase journey. We also connect e-commerce platforms to UAE logistics providers, inventory systems, and CRMs as required.

Can you connect my website to third-party tools like CRM, email marketing, or booking systems?

Yes. Modern business websites rarely exist in isolation — they need to integrate with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho), email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo), booking systems, live chat tools, WhatsApp Business API, and often ERP or inventory systems. We handle all of these integrations as part of our web development service, with full testing and documentation.

What is your web design process?

Our process has five phases: (1) Discovery — we understand your business, audience, competitors, and goals; (2) Strategy — sitemap, user journey mapping, and content planning; (3) Design — wireframes, then full visual design with 2 rounds of revisions included; (4) Development — pixel-perfect build with full testing; (5) Launch and handover — analytics setup, training, and go-live support. We provide a dedicated project manager for every project so you always have a single point of contact.

Do you provide website copywriting?

Yes — as an optional add-on. We strongly recommend professional copywriting for business websites because the words are ultimately what convert visitors into customers. Our copywriting service includes messaging strategy, SEO keyword integration, and professional English copywriting. For Arabic content, we work with specialist UAE-based Arabic copywriters. Poor copy is one of the most common reasons a well-designed website fails to generate enquiries.

How do you ensure my website is secure?

Security is built into our development process, not bolted on afterwards. For WordPress sites: we use only reputable, actively maintained plugins; implement file permission hardening; set up a Web Application Firewall (WAF); configure regular automated backups (stored offsite); install SSL certificates; and restrict login access by IP where appropriate. We also recommend and configure ongoing security monitoring as part of our maintenance plans.

Can I update my website myself after it's built?

Absolutely — this is a core goal of every website we build. We use WordPress because it has the most intuitive content management system available. We configure the CMS specifically for each client, so the editing experience is as simple as possible. We also provide training sessions (recorded for future reference) for every project handover. You should be able to update text, images, blog posts, and service pages without any developer involvement.

How do I get started with a web design project?

The first step is a free discovery consultation — typically 45–60 minutes — where we discuss your business, goals, current website challenges, and initial budget range. Following that, we'll provide a detailed proposal with scope, timeline, and fixed price. There's no obligation and no hard sell. Book your free consultation here, or browse our case studies to see examples of our work first.
