item.title: Web Development Services Dubai — WordPress, React & Custom Builds
item.content:encoded:
Exceptional web design means nothing if the underlying code is slow, insecure, or breaks under real-world conditions. Our web development service builds the technical infrastructure your digital presence demands — clean, performant, secure, and scalable code that performs under load, protects your users' data, and gives your team the control they need without depending on a developer for routine updates.

We build websites and web applications that combine technical excellence with maintainability. Every project is documented, tested, and handed over with the training your team needs to manage it confidently. We don't create dependencies — we build independence.

Our Web Development Services

WordPress Development

WordPress is our primary platform — and for most business websites, the right choice. We build bespoke WordPress themes (not purchased templates) from scratch, with custom post types, Advanced Custom Fields, and fully flexible content management. Our WordPress builds are fast (Core Web Vitals-optimised from day one), secure (hardened against common attack vectors), and built to be managed by your team without developer dependency.

We specialise in complex WordPress projects: multi-site networks, WooCommerce stores with custom checkout flows, membership sites, directory websites, booking systems, and WordPress as a headless CMS feeding custom front-end applications.

WooCommerce Development

WooCommerce powers the majority of UAE e-commerce stores on WordPress. We build and customise WooCommerce stores with complex product configurations (variable products, subscriptions, bundles), custom checkout flows that reduce cart abandonment, integration with UAE payment gateways (Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, Amazon Payment Services), and API connections to inventory management, fulfilment, and CRM systems.

Our WooCommerce builds are performance-optimised — a critical consideration for e-commerce, where a 1-second page speed improvement can increase conversions by 7% and every millisecond of load time has a measurable impact on revenue.

Custom Web Applications

For complex business requirements that go beyond what website CMS platforms can handle, we build custom web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue) and robust backend systems (Node.js, PHP Laravel, Python). Whether you need a customer portal, an operations dashboard, a SaaS application, a booking and reservation system, or a complex API-driven platform, we architect and build it for your specific requirements.

API Development and Integration

Modern business operations require connected systems. We build RESTful and GraphQL APIs, integrate third-party services (CRM, ERP, payment gateways, shipping, email marketing, accounting, and more), and create the technical bridges that allow your website to communicate with your business systems in real time. Proper API architecture makes your business more efficient and your website more powerful.

Website Migration and Rebuild

Migrating an existing website — whether from another platform, another agency's work, or an outdated custom build — requires careful planning to preserve SEO value, data integrity, and functionality. We manage migrations with comprehensive redirect mapping, search console monitoring, and post-migration performance verification to ensure your organic rankings are protected through the transition.

Performance Optimisation

Website speed is a revenue driver and a ranking factor. We offer standalone performance audits and optimisation services for existing websites struggling with slow load times, poor Core Web Vitals scores, or high server response times. Our optimisation work covers: server configuration and hosting upgrades, caching implementation, image optimisation and next-gen format delivery (WebP/AVIF), JavaScript and CSS minification and deferral, critical CSS inlining, and CDN configuration.

Technical Standards We Build To

Performance

Every website we deliver is built to achieve Google's "Good" threshold for Core Web Vitals: LCP under 2.5 seconds, INP under 200ms, and CLS under 0.1. We use server-side rendering or static generation where appropriate to minimise client-side JavaScript, implement aggressive caching strategies, and configure CDN delivery for optimal load times across the UAE and GCC.

Security

Website security is non-negotiable — particularly for businesses handling customer data, payment information, or sensitive enquiries. Our security standards include: HTTPS implementation with modern TLS configuration, input validation and SQL injection prevention, XSS (cross-site scripting) protection, CSRF (cross-site request forgery) tokens on all forms, regular dependency updates and vulnerability monitoring, secure file upload handling, and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints.

For WordPress specifically: we implement WordPress security hardening (removing version exposure, limiting login attempts, two-factor authentication for admin, file permission audits) and configure monitoring to detect and alert on suspicious activity.

Accessibility

Web accessibility — building sites that work for users with disabilities — is both the right thing to do and, increasingly, a legal requirement in many jurisdictions. We build to WCAG 2.1 AA standards as standard, covering: proper semantic HTML structure, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, sufficient colour contrast, alternative text for images, and accessible form design.

Code Quality and Maintainability

All code we write is clean, documented, and maintainable. We follow established coding standards for each language and framework, use version control (Git) throughout every project, write meaningful commit messages, and provide full code documentation in the project handover. When your team or a future developer picks up the project, they should be able to understand it quickly.

UAE-Specific Development Considerations

Payment gateway integration: UAE-compliant payment processing requires local gateway options beyond Stripe. We integrate PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, Amazon Payment Services, and network-branded gateways, ensuring your checkout works seamlessly with UAE-issued Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Apple Pay.

Arabic language support: RTL (right-to-left) development for Arabic interfaces requires more than translating content — it means mirrored layouts, correctly-rendered Arabic typography (font selection is critical; not all fonts render Arabic correctly), bidirectional text handling, and appropriately adapted UX patterns. We've delivered fully bilingual Arabic/English applications.

UAE data residency: Some UAE businesses — particularly in regulated sectors — require data to be stored and processed within the UAE. We architect solutions on UAE cloud infrastructure (Azure UAE North, AWS Bahrain, Oracle UAE) where data residency is a requirement.

Bandwidth and device diversity: While UAE internet speeds are excellent in urban areas, the device mix is diverse — from premium smartphones to lower-end Android devices. We optimise for the full range of UAE device capabilities, ensuring performance across the spectrum.

Why Technical Excellence Matters for Business

The business case for technical excellence is straightforward: a faster website converts better, ranks higher, and retains more users. A secure website protects your reputation and your customers. A well-built website gives your team independence rather than dependency. And a scalable architecture means you don't face a costly rebuild when your business grows.

We've seen the consequences of underinvesting in technical quality: websites that can't handle traffic spikes and go down during marketing campaigns, e-commerce stores that lose thousands in sales to checkout bugs, and WordPress sites hacked and defaced because of neglected security. Technical investment is insurance against these risks — and it compounds in value over time.

Our Development Technology Stack

Our team works across a broad range of technologies, selecting the right tool for each project rather than forcing every brief into a single framework:

Frontend: HTML5, CSS3/Sass, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP animations

Backend: PHP 8+, Laravel, WordPress, Node.js, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL

Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (caching)

Infrastructure: Nginx, Apache, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Cloudflare, AWS, Azure UAE, Kinsta, WP Engine

Tools: Git, Webpack/Vite, Figma-to-code workflows, browser testing suites, Lighthouse CI

Technologies We Use

We are technology-agnostic in the sense that we select the best tool for each project — but we are deeply expert in a specific, carefully chosen technology stack. Every technology in our stack was selected because it is production-proven, actively maintained, well-documented, and supported by large developer communities. We don't experiment with client projects using untested frameworks.

Technology Category Best Used For Why We Use It
WordPress CMS / Web Framework Business websites, blogs, content-heavy sites Powers 43% of the web; unmatched ecosystem, flexibility, and client usability
WooCommerce E-Commerce Online stores, UAE e-commerce Most extensible e-commerce platform; UAE payment gateway support
React Front-End JavaScript Interactive UIs, SPAs, component libraries Industry standard; component-based architecture; massive developer community
Next.js React Framework High-performance sites, headless CMS front-ends Server-side rendering for SEO + React component flexibility
Laravel PHP Framework Custom web apps, APIs, complex back-end logic Elegant, expressive PHP; excellent for complex business logic and REST APIs
Node.js Back-End JavaScript Real-time applications, APIs, microservices High performance for I/O-bound operations; JavaScript full-stack capability
Python / Django Back-End / Data Data-driven apps, AI integrations, automation Excellent for data processing, ML integrations, and rapid API development
MySQL / PostgreSQL Database Relational data storage for most web applications Battle-tested, ACID-compliant, widely supported
Redis Caching / Sessions Performance caching, session management Sub-millisecond data access; dramatically improves application performance
AWS / Cloudflare Infrastructure / CDN Hosting, CDN, security, DNS UAE data residency options; enterprise-grade reliability; global CDN performance

Our technology decisions are always client-benefit driven. We explain our recommendations in plain language and match the technology to the business problem — not to what happens to be fashionable. When you work with our web design and development team, you get a technology partner who builds for long-term maintainability and scalability.

UAE Web Development Market: Context and Opportunity

Understanding the digital landscape in the UAE is essential context for any web development project. Dubai and the broader UAE are not just emerging markets — they are among the most digitally advanced economies in the world, with government initiatives and private sector investment driving rapid adoption of technology across every sector.

Dubai's Smart City Vision

The Smart Dubai initiative — launched in 2014 and continuously expanded — aims to make Dubai the happiest and smartest city on earth through technology. This has driven widespread digital transformation across government services, retail, hospitality, finance, and healthcare. The Dubai Digital Economy Strategy targets digital economy contributions of 20% of total GDP. For businesses, this means digital presence is not optional — it's a prerequisite for competing in the market.

UAE E-Commerce Growth

The UAE e-commerce market reached approximately USD 5.5 billion in 2023 and is projected to exceed USD 9 billion by 2026, with a compound annual growth rate of over 15%. Mobile commerce accounts for approximately 68% of all e-commerce transactions in the UAE. Dubai alone hosts over 15,000 e-commerce businesses, ranging from solo-operated stores to regional enterprise retailers. Building a robust, fast, and conversion-optimised e-commerce website is one of the highest-ROI investments a UAE retailer can make. Our SEO services help drive organic traffic to these e-commerce properties.

Internet and Mobile Penetration

The UAE has one of the world's highest internet penetration rates at approximately 99% of the population, and smartphone penetration exceeds 97%. Average mobile internet speeds in Dubai regularly exceed 100 Mbps on 5G networks, meaning users have high expectations for website performance — and no patience for slow-loading sites. This makes performance optimisation not just good practice but a commercial necessity.

Tech Talent and Innovation Ecosystem

Dubai's D3 (Dubai Design District), Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Silicon Oasis host thousands of tech companies and tens of thousands of technology professionals. The UAE Golden Visa programme has attracted international tech talent, raising the overall quality and competitiveness of the digital services market. For businesses commissioning web development, this means the quality bar for agency work is high — and choosing an experienced, technically proficient partner matters more than ever.

UAE PDPL and Data Compliance

The UAE Federal Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) came into force in 2022, establishing comprehensive data protection requirements for businesses operating in the UAE. Any website that collects personal data — which includes contact forms, newsletter sign-ups, and e-commerce checkouts — must comply with PDPL requirements including privacy policy disclosure, data subject rights, and appropriate data security measures. Our development practice includes PDPL compliance review as a standard component of every project.

Our Development Standards

Every website and web application we build adheres to a consistent set of technical and quality standards. These aren't optional extras — they're baseline requirements that every project must meet before it goes live.

Security Standards

Web security is a growing concern for UAE businesses of all sizes. Cyberattacks targeting UAE businesses increased by 71% in 2023 according to IBM's X-Force Threat Intelligence Report. Our security standards include:

  • OWASP Top 10 compliance: We test against the industry-standard list of the most critical web application security risks
  • HTTPS everywhere: SSL/TLS certificates installed and enforced across all domains and subdomains
  • SQL injection prevention: Parameterised queries and input sanitisation throughout all database interactions
  • XSS protection: Output encoding and Content Security Policy (CSP) headers configured
  • Authentication hardening: Strong password requirements, rate limiting, and multi-factor authentication where applicable
  • Regular dependency audits: Automated scanning for known vulnerabilities in third-party packages
  • Encrypted data storage: Sensitive data encrypted at rest; PII handled according to UAE PDPL requirements

Performance Standards

Performance directly impacts both user experience and search rankings. Our performance standards align with Google's Core Web Vitals thresholds:

  • Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): Under 2.5 seconds on mobile
  • Interaction to Next Paint (INP): Under 200 milliseconds
  • Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): Under 0.1
  • Google PageSpeed Insights score: 85+ on mobile, 90+ on desktop
  • Image optimisation: WebP format, lazy loading, and appropriate sizing for all images
  • Code minification: CSS, JavaScript, and HTML minified and compressed for all production builds
  • CDN delivery: Static assets served from Cloudflare or AWS CloudFront for global performance

Accessibility and WCAG 2.1

Web accessibility is both a legal consideration and a commercial opportunity. The UAE has approximately 1.4 million people with disabilities, and accessible websites serve this audience while also improving usability for all users. We build to WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards as a baseline:

  • Sufficient colour contrast ratios for all text elements
  • Keyboard navigability throughout all interactive elements
  • Screen reader compatibility with appropriate ARIA labels
  • Alternative text for all informational images
  • Video captions for embedded video content
  • Focus indicators for all interactive elements

Arabic RTL Development Standards

Building truly bilingual Arabic/English websites requires more than CSS direction switching. Our RTL development standards include:

  • Logical CSS properties (margin-inline, padding-inline) for automatic RTL adaptation
  • Font selection and line-height optimised for Arabic typography
  • Icon and image mirroring where directional meaning applies
  • Form field alignment and input direction adjusted for Arabic data entry
  • Bidirectional (BiDi) text handling for mixed Arabic/English content
  • Testing with native Arabic-speaking users before any bilingual site launches

These standards are part of why businesses across Dubai and the wider UAE trust us with complex web development projects. Learn more about our overall approach on our about page.

Common Web Development Mistakes That Damage UAE Businesses

Web development mistakes are often invisible to business owners until they cause a measurable problem — a site goes down, rankings drop, or a security breach exposes customer data. Here are the most costly development mistakes we see in UAE websites.

1. Building on Shared Hosting for Business-Critical Sites

Shared hosting (where your site shares server resources with hundreds of other sites) is appropriate for personal blogs and hobby projects. For a business website handling enquiries, e-commerce transactions, or significant traffic, shared hosting creates performance instability, security exposure (a breach on one site can affect all sites on the server), and unreliable uptime. We recommend managed WordPress hosting (WP Engine, Kinsta, Cloudways) or AWS/DigitalOcean VPS configurations for all business websites.

2. Using Untested or Abandoned Plugins

WordPress's plugin ecosystem is a strength and a vulnerability. There are over 60,000 plugins available — but a significant portion are poorly maintained, incompatible with recent WordPress versions, or outright abandoned. Each plugin is a potential security and performance liability. We audit every plugin in a project against update frequency, active installation count, compatibility, and code quality before including it.

3. Ignoring Database Optimisation

As WordPress sites accumulate content, revisions, and data over years, database performance degrades. Unoptimised databases with thousands of post revisions, orphaned metadata, and unindexed tables are a common cause of slow admin panels and slow front-end queries. We implement database optimisation as part of every build and include it in ongoing maintenance plans.

4. No Staging Environment

Making changes directly to a live website is reckless. A coding error, a plugin conflict, or a failed update can bring a business-critical site offline for hours. Every project we manage has a staging environment (an exact clone of the live site) where all changes are tested before being deployed to production.

5. Inadequate Backup Strategy

We regularly encounter businesses whose websites have never had a successful backup taken. When a site is compromised, infected with malware, or accidentally broken, the ability to restore from a recent clean backup is the difference between a one-hour recovery and days of rebuilding. We configure automated daily backups stored offsite (not on the same server as the website) for every project.

6. Hardcoding Content That Should Be Dynamic

Developers sometimes hardcode content (phone numbers, addresses, prices, team names) directly into theme templates rather than making it manageable through the CMS. This creates situations where a simple update — like changing a phone number — requires developer involvement and deployment. We build content management flexibility into every element that a business might reasonably need to update.

7. Building Without Performance Testing

A website that performs well with 10 simultaneous users may break entirely under 500 concurrent visits — exactly the scenario during a marketing campaign, product launch, or press mention. Load testing before launch identifies and resolves performance bottlenecks before they become business-damaging incidents. This is especially relevant for e-commerce sites running promotional campaigns.

8. No Monitoring After Launch

Websites don't stay healthy on their own. Server resources fill up, plugins develop conflicts, certificates expire, and traffic patterns change. Without monitoring tools (uptime monitoring, error logging, performance tracking), problems go undetected until a customer reports them — often too late. We set up comprehensive monitoring dashboards for every site we build, with alert thresholds that notify us before issues become outages.

Key Takeaways

🔑 What to Remember About Web Development in Dubai

  • The UAE e-commerce market is growing at 15%+ CAGR — a robust technical platform is essential for capitalising on this growth
  • Cyberattacks targeting UAE businesses increased by 71% in 2023 — security must be built in, not added later
  • Core Web Vitals scores directly impact Google rankings — performance is an SEO requirement, not just a UX nice-to-have
  • WordPress powers 43% of all websites globally and remains the most maintainable, flexible CMS for most business projects
  • Genuine RTL Arabic support requires purpose-built development — not just a CSS direction switch
  • UAE PDPL compliance is a legal requirement for any website collecting personal data from UAE residents
  • A staging environment is non-negotiable for any production website — changes should never be made live directly
  • The right technology choice depends on your business requirements — not on what's trendy in developer circles
  • Post-launch monitoring and maintenance prevents the majority of website incidents and security breaches

Frequently Asked Questions: Web Development in Dubai

How long does web development take for a Dubai business website?

Development timelines vary by project complexity. A straightforward business website on WordPress typically takes 3–6 weeks for development once designs are approved. WooCommerce e-commerce stores generally require 6–12 weeks. Custom web applications with complex back-end logic and integrations typically take 12–24 weeks or more. The development timeline runs concurrently with or follows the web design phase, so total project timelines from kick-off to launch are typically 8–24 weeks depending on scope. We provide a detailed timeline in every project proposal.

What CMS options do you recommend for UAE businesses?

WordPress is our primary recommendation for most business websites — it powers 43% of the internet for good reason. It has the most mature ecosystem of plugins, themes, and developer support globally, and it's the platform your team can most easily learn to manage. For e-commerce, WooCommerce (built on WordPress) is our default recommendation, with Shopify considered for simpler product catalogues. For enterprise projects requiring custom content architectures, we sometimes use WordPress as a headless CMS with a Next.js front-end. We recommend against platform builders like Wix and Squarespace for any business serious about SEO and long-term scalability.

Where will my website be hosted?

We recommend and configure managed hosting environments appropriate to the project scale. For most business websites, managed WordPress hosting providers (WP Engine, Kinsta, or Cloudways) offer the best balance of performance, security, and cost. For enterprise projects or applications requiring more control, we configure AWS EC2 or DigitalOcean droplets. All our hosting recommendations include UAE or Middle East data centre options for PDPL compliance and regional performance. We do not lock clients into any specific hosting provider — the hosting account is always in the client's name.

How do you handle website security?

Security is integrated throughout our development process. We follow OWASP Top 10 security guidelines, implement SSL certificates, configure Web Application Firewalls, set up automated malware scanning, harden file permissions, implement strong authentication controls, and conduct security testing before every launch. For WordPress specifically, we lock down admin access, disable file editing, and configure a comprehensive security plugin suite. We also include security monitoring in our ongoing maintenance plans, as threats evolve continuously.

Can you integrate my website with third-party systems?

Yes — API and third-party integration is a core part of our development capability. We regularly integrate websites with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM), email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign), payment gateways (Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay), ERP systems, inventory management platforms, booking systems, WhatsApp Business API, and custom REST APIs. We document all integrations thoroughly so your team understands the data flows and dependencies.

Do you build websites that support Arabic and English?

Yes. Bilingual Arabic/English development is a specialisation of ours. True Arabic RTL support goes beyond CSS — it requires rethinking layout logic, typography, form behaviour, and icon direction for the right-to-left reading context. We build bilingual sites using WordPress's multilingual plugins (WPML or Polylang) with proper language switching, hreflang tags for SEO, and native RTL CSS using logical properties. We test with native Arabic speakers before launch.

What happens if my website breaks after launch?

All clients on our monthly maintenance plans have priority support response times — typically same-day or next-business-day for non-critical issues, and within 2 hours for site-down emergencies. We maintain recent backups for rapid restoration. For clients not on a maintenance plan, we provide paid emergency support. We recommend all business websites have some form of ongoing support arrangement, as unmonitored WordPress sites can develop issues over time through plugin conflicts, WordPress updates, or security events.

Can you take over maintenance of a website someone else built?

Yes — we regularly take on maintenance and development of websites built by previous agencies or freelancers. We conduct a full technical audit first to assess the current state of the codebase, security, performance, and technical debt. We'll be honest about what we find: sometimes a site can be maintained effectively; other times a rebuild is the more cost-effective long-term solution. The audit cost is credited against any subsequent project.

How do you approach accessibility and WCAG compliance?

We build to WCAG 2.1 Level AA as a baseline standard for all projects. This includes sufficient colour contrast, keyboard navigability, screen reader compatibility (ARIA labels), alternative text for images, and focus indicators. For government tenders and large enterprise clients, we can provide accessibility audit reports and remediation documentation. Accessibility also improves SEO — accessible HTML is semantically correct HTML, which search engines read more effectively.

Will my website perform well on Google Core Web Vitals?

Yes — we target 85+ on Google PageSpeed Insights mobile score for every project. This requires performance-conscious development from the start: optimised images (WebP format, appropriate sizing, lazy loading), minimised CSS and JavaScript, efficient font loading, CDN delivery for static assets, and server-side caching. We verify Core Web Vitals compliance in both lab and field data before launch. Strong Core Web Vitals scores contribute to SEO performance and provide a better experience for the 78% of UAE users on mobile devices.

Do you offer e-commerce development for UAE businesses?

Yes. We build WooCommerce stores integrated with UAE payment gateways (Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, Amazon Payment Services), UAE shipping providers, and where required, UAE customs and VAT calculation systems. We also handle complex product configurations — variable products, subscriptions, bundles, and digital downloads. For UAE e-commerce businesses, we pay particular attention to mobile checkout flow, as approximately 68% of UAE e-commerce transactions are completed on mobile devices. Learn more about our PPC management services to drive paid traffic to your e-commerce store.

What is your development quality assurance process?

Every project goes through a structured QA process before launch: cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge), cross-device testing (iOS and Android, multiple screen sizes), functionality testing of all forms and interactive elements, performance testing, security scanning, accessibility checking, and SEO technical review. We maintain a comprehensive pre-launch checklist with over 60 checkpoints that every project must pass. We also conduct load testing for e-commerce sites and any project expecting significant traffic volumes.

Can you build a custom web application — not just a website?

Yes. In addition to websites, we build custom web applications: SaaS products, client portals, booking and reservation systems, directory and marketplace platforms, membership sites, and internal business tools. These projects typically use our Laravel or Node.js back-end stack with a React or Next.js front-end. We follow agile development methodology with regular sprint reviews so clients see and provide feedback on progress throughout the build — not just at the end.

Do you provide the source code and documentation?

Absolutely. All source code for client projects is owned by the client. We deliver projects via a version-controlled Git repository (GitHub or Bitbucket), with comprehensive technical documentation covering the system architecture, deployment procedures, third-party integrations, and CMS usage. We never retain ownership of client code or create proprietary dependencies that lock clients into working with us. Our goal is to build your capability and independence, not dependency.

How do you handle website updates and WordPress version upgrades?

WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates are the most common source of website issues if not managed carefully. Major WordPress updates occasionally introduce breaking changes that require developer attention. Our maintenance service manages all updates on a staging environment first, verifies compatibility and functionality, then deploys to live — never updating production directly. We also monitor the WordPress security team's disclosures and apply security patches as a priority outside the normal update schedule when critical vulnerabilities are announced.

How do I start a web development project with you?

Start with a free discovery call where we discuss your project requirements, technical constraints, integration needs, and timeline. We'll ask the right questions to fully scope the project. Following the call, we provide a detailed proposal with a fixed price, timeline, and deliverables specification. There are no hidden costs and no ongoing retainer obligations beyond the agreed project scope. Book your free consultation here. You can also explore our full range of digital services or read our blog for technical insights into web development best practices.

Related Services

Excellent web development creates the technical foundation — but the full return on investment comes from integrating development with strategy, design, and ongoing digital marketing.

  • Web Design — Bespoke visual design that converts visitors into customers, built for the UAE market
  • SEO Services — Technical SEO, content strategy, and link building to rank your new website on Google
  • AI Search Optimisation — Structure your content to appear in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT answers
  • PPC Management — Google Ads campaigns that drive immediate traffic while organic rankings build
  • Social Media Marketing — Extend your digital presence across the platforms your UAE audience uses daily

Need a Technical Partner for Your Web Project?

Whether you're building from scratch, need to rescue an underperforming site, or want to develop a custom web application, we have the technical depth to deliver it. Book a free technical consultation — no sales pressure, just expert advice.

Get a Free Technical Consultation View Case Studies

Explore our work in Dubai and across the UAE, read expert development insights on our blog, or learn more about our team on the about page. We're also available to discuss your project directly — just get in touch.

Build scalable, high-performance web applications, e-commerce platforms, and custom digital products engineered for speed, security, and seamless user experiences across the UAE and beyond.
Custom WordPress development with bespoke themes, plugins, and integrations
WooCommerce ecommerce development for UAE online stores with local payment gateways
React and Next.js application development for dynamic, app-like web experiences
Arabic language support with full RTL implementation across all platforms
UAE payment gateway integration — PayFort, Telr, Network International, Stripe
REST API development and third-party API integration (CRM, ERP, payment, shipping)
Performance-first development — Core Web Vitals optimised from initial build
Security hardening, SSL, GDPR/PDPL compliance for UAE regulatory requirements
Scalable hosting on Dubai-based or UAE-compliant cloud infrastructure
Ongoing maintenance, updates, and 24/7 monitoring for production applications
We map your technical requirements, integration points, scalability needs, and existing infrastructure to architect a solution that solves today's problems without creating tomorrow's technical debt.

We recommend the right stack based on your requirements: WordPress for CMS flexibility, WooCommerce for ecommerce, React/Next.js for complex applications, or custom PHP/Node.js for unique needs. There is no one-size-fits-all in web development.

Agile development in 2-week sprints with regular demos ensures you see progress continuously, can provide feedback early, and are never surprised at delivery. All code is version-controlled with Git, enabling safe rollbacks at any time.

We integrate your website with the external systems your business depends on — CRMs, ERPs, payment gateways, shipping providers, accounting systems, marketing automation tools, and custom APIs — ensuring your website is a connected hub.

Comprehensive testing across browsers, devices, and screen sizes. Performance testing against Core Web Vitals benchmarks. Security audits. Load testing for high-traffic scenarios. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) verification. Nothing ships until it passes every check.

Staged deployment from development to staging to production ensures zero-downtime launches. We configure CDN, caching, SSL, server optimisation, and monitoring before go-live. Launch is coordinated for minimal business impact.

Post-launch support packages range from basic monitoring and updates to dedicated monthly development retainers. We become your long-term technology partner, continuously improving and extending your platform as your business grows.
Should my Dubai business use WordPress or a custom CMS?

WordPress powers 43% of the world's websites and is our recommended solution for the majority of Dubai business websites. It offers unmatched content management flexibility, the largest plugin ecosystem, excellent SEO capabilities, strong security when properly maintained, and lower long-term costs than custom CMS development. Custom CMS makes sense only when you have very specific workflow requirements WordPress genuinely cannot meet — which is rare.
What UAE payment gateways can you integrate into a website?

We integrate all major UAE-compliant payment gateways: PayFort (Amazon Payment Services) — the most widely used in the UAE; Telr — excellent for SME ecommerce; Network International — preferred by large enterprises; Stripe — strong developer tooling; and PayPal. We also handle Apple Pay and Google Pay integration. For BNPL, we integrate tabby and Tamara — increasingly important for UAE ecommerce conversion.
Can you build a website that supports Arabic and English with RTL?

Yes. Bilingual Arabic-English web development is a core competency. Full RTL Arabic support requires custom theme development with bidirectional layout support, Arabic font stack implementation, separate Arabic and English admin interfaces in the CMS, hreflang implementation for proper Google language targeting, and testing across all browsers and devices for both language versions.
How do you ensure a website is fast and meets Core Web Vitals?

Performance is engineered from architecture through deployment: server-side rendering for first-paint speed; image optimisation (WebP, lazy loading, responsive images); code splitting and tree-shaking; efficient CSS without render-blocking stylesheets; CDN implementation; database query optimisation; server-level caching (Redis/Memcached); and HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 protocol. We target LCP under 2.5s, INP under 200ms, and CLS below 0.1 — Google's "Good" thresholds for ranking.
What is headless WordPress and when should I use it?

Headless WordPress separates the CMS backend from the frontend presentation layer (typically React or Next.js). This delivers superior performance — pages served as static HTML via CDN — and allows for extremely custom user experiences. We recommend headless for high-traffic sites (100,000+ monthly visitors) or applications requiring app-like interactivity. For most Dubai SMEs, traditional WordPress delivers excellent performance at lower cost.
Can you build a WooCommerce store for my UAE ecommerce business?

Yes. WooCommerce handles unlimited products, complex variable products, multiple currencies (AED, USD, GBP), UAE tax configuration, Aramex and DHL API integration, all major UAE payment gateways, Arabic language support, and SEO optimisation for product and category pages. We have built WooCommerce stores processing AED 1M+ monthly transactions for UAE clients across fashion, electronics, beauty, and food sectors.
How do you handle website security for Dubai businesses?

Security implementation includes: SSL certificate installation and HTTPS enforcement; WordPress core, theme, and plugin update management; Web Application Firewall (WAF) configuration; two-factor authentication for admin access; database hardening; file permission hardening; regular malware scanning; and login attempt limiting. For ecommerce sites handling payment data, we implement additional PCI-DSS compliant security measures.
What hosting do you recommend for Dubai businesses?

For UAE businesses, we recommend: AWS Middle East Region (Bahrain) for enterprise and high-traffic sites — lowest latency for UAE visitors; SiteGround or Kinsta for managed WordPress hosting; and Digital Ocean for custom application hosting. For UAE-based hosting satisfying data residency requirements, we work with Etisalat e-Cloud and du Datamena. We avoid generic shared hosting for business-critical websites.
Do you offer ongoing website maintenance and support?

Yes. All clients receive 30 days of post-launch support. Beyond that, monthly maintenance packages cover: WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates; uptime monitoring; weekly automated backups; monthly security scans; Core Web Vitals monitoring; and development hours. Packages start from AED 500/month for basic monitoring to AED 2,500/month for comprehensive care. Contact us to discuss your maintenance needs.
Can you migrate my existing website to a new platform?

Yes. Platform migrations — from Squarespace, Wix, or custom CMS to WordPress; from Shopify to WooCommerce — are regular work. Our migration process includes complete content audit and migration, URL structure preservation with 301 redirect mapping, meta data transfer, image optimisation during migration, and post-migration SEO monitoring to catch any ranking impact immediately. A well-executed migration should improve rather than harm your SEO performance.

Exceptional web design means nothing if the underlying code is slow, insecure, or breaks under real-world conditions. Our web development service builds the technical infrastructure your digital presence demands — clean, performant, secure, and scalable code that performs under load, protects your users' data, and gives your team the control they need without depending on a developer for routine updates.

We build websites and web applications that combine technical excellence with maintainability. Every project is documented, tested, and handed over with the training your team needs to manage it confidently. We don't create dependencies — we build independence.

Our Web Development Services

WordPress Development

WordPress is our primary platform — and for most business websites, the right choice. We build bespoke WordPress themes (not purchased templates) from scratch, with custom post types, Advanced Custom Fields, and fully flexible content management. Our WordPress builds are fast (Core Web Vitals-optimised from day one), secure (hardened against common attack vectors), and built to be managed by your team without developer dependency.

We specialise in complex WordPress projects: multi-site networks, WooCommerce stores with custom checkout flows, membership sites, directory websites, booking systems, and WordPress as a headless CMS feeding custom front-end applications.

WooCommerce Development

WooCommerce powers the majority of UAE e-commerce stores on WordPress. We build and customise WooCommerce stores with complex product configurations (variable products, subscriptions, bundles), custom checkout flows that reduce cart abandonment, integration with UAE payment gateways (Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, Amazon Payment Services), and API connections to inventory management, fulfilment, and CRM systems.

Our WooCommerce builds are performance-optimised — a critical consideration for e-commerce, where a 1-second page speed improvement can increase conversions by 7% and every millisecond of load time has a measurable impact on revenue.

Custom Web Applications

For complex business requirements that go beyond what website CMS platforms can handle, we build custom web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue) and robust backend systems (Node.js, PHP Laravel, Python). Whether you need a customer portal, an operations dashboard, a SaaS application, a booking and reservation system, or a complex API-driven platform, we architect and build it for your specific requirements.

API Development and Integration

Modern business operations require connected systems. We build RESTful and GraphQL APIs, integrate third-party services (CRM, ERP, payment gateways, shipping, email marketing, accounting, and more), and create the technical bridges that allow your website to communicate with your business systems in real time. Proper API architecture makes your business more efficient and your website more powerful.

Website Migration and Rebuild

Migrating an existing website — whether from another platform, another agency's work, or an outdated custom build — requires careful planning to preserve SEO value, data integrity, and functionality. We manage migrations with comprehensive redirect mapping, search console monitoring, and post-migration performance verification to ensure your organic rankings are protected through the transition.

Performance Optimisation

Website speed is a revenue driver and a ranking factor. We offer standalone performance audits and optimisation services for existing websites struggling with slow load times, poor Core Web Vitals scores, or high server response times. Our optimisation work covers: server configuration and hosting upgrades, caching implementation, image optimisation and next-gen format delivery (WebP/AVIF), JavaScript and CSS minification and deferral, critical CSS inlining, and CDN configuration.

Technical Standards We Build To

Performance

Every website we deliver is built to achieve Google's "Good" threshold for Core Web Vitals: LCP under 2.5 seconds, INP under 200ms, and CLS under 0.1. We use server-side rendering or static generation where appropriate to minimise client-side JavaScript, implement aggressive caching strategies, and configure CDN delivery for optimal load times across the UAE and GCC.

Security

Website security is non-negotiable — particularly for businesses handling customer data, payment information, or sensitive enquiries. Our security standards include: HTTPS implementation with modern TLS configuration, input validation and SQL injection prevention, XSS (cross-site scripting) protection, CSRF (cross-site request forgery) tokens on all forms, regular dependency updates and vulnerability monitoring, secure file upload handling, and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints.

For WordPress specifically: we implement WordPress security hardening (removing version exposure, limiting login attempts, two-factor authentication for admin, file permission audits) and configure monitoring to detect and alert on suspicious activity.

Accessibility

Web accessibility — building sites that work for users with disabilities — is both the right thing to do and, increasingly, a legal requirement in many jurisdictions. We build to WCAG 2.1 AA standards as standard, covering: proper semantic HTML structure, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, sufficient colour contrast, alternative text for images, and accessible form design.

Code Quality and Maintainability

All code we write is clean, documented, and maintainable. We follow established coding standards for each language and framework, use version control (Git) throughout every project, write meaningful commit messages, and provide full code documentation in the project handover. When your team or a future developer picks up the project, they should be able to understand it quickly.

UAE-Specific Development Considerations

Payment gateway integration: UAE-compliant payment processing requires local gateway options beyond Stripe. We integrate PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, Amazon Payment Services, and network-branded gateways, ensuring your checkout works seamlessly with UAE-issued Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Apple Pay.

Arabic language support: RTL (right-to-left) development for Arabic interfaces requires more than translating content — it means mirrored layouts, correctly-rendered Arabic typography (font selection is critical; not all fonts render Arabic correctly), bidirectional text handling, and appropriately adapted UX patterns. We've delivered fully bilingual Arabic/English applications.

UAE data residency: Some UAE businesses — particularly in regulated sectors — require data to be stored and processed within the UAE. We architect solutions on UAE cloud infrastructure (Azure UAE North, AWS Bahrain, Oracle UAE) where data residency is a requirement.

Bandwidth and device diversity: While UAE internet speeds are excellent in urban areas, the device mix is diverse — from premium smartphones to lower-end Android devices. We optimise for the full range of UAE device capabilities, ensuring performance across the spectrum.

Why Technical Excellence Matters for Business

The business case for technical excellence is straightforward: a faster website converts better, ranks higher, and retains more users. A secure website protects your reputation and your customers. A well-built website gives your team independence rather than dependency. And a scalable architecture means you don't face a costly rebuild when your business grows.

We've seen the consequences of underinvesting in technical quality: websites that can't handle traffic spikes and go down during marketing campaigns, e-commerce stores that lose thousands in sales to checkout bugs, and WordPress sites hacked and defaced because of neglected security. Technical investment is insurance against these risks — and it compounds in value over time.

Our Development Technology Stack

Our team works across a broad range of technologies, selecting the right tool for each project rather than forcing every brief into a single framework:

Frontend: HTML5, CSS3/Sass, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP animations

Backend: PHP 8+, Laravel, WordPress, Node.js, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL

Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (caching)

Infrastructure: Nginx, Apache, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Cloudflare, AWS, Azure UAE, Kinsta, WP Engine

Tools: Git, Webpack/Vite, Figma-to-code workflows, browser testing suites, Lighthouse CI

Technologies We Use

We are technology-agnostic in the sense that we select the best tool for each project — but we are deeply expert in a specific, carefully chosen technology stack. Every technology in our stack was selected because it is production-proven, actively maintained, well-documented, and supported by large developer communities. We don't experiment with client projects using untested frameworks.

Technology Category Best Used For Why We Use It
WordPress CMS / Web Framework Business websites, blogs, content-heavy sites Powers 43% of the web; unmatched ecosystem, flexibility, and client usability
WooCommerce E-Commerce Online stores, UAE e-commerce Most extensible e-commerce platform; UAE payment gateway support
React Front-End JavaScript Interactive UIs, SPAs, component libraries Industry standard; component-based architecture; massive developer community
Next.js React Framework High-performance sites, headless CMS front-ends Server-side rendering for SEO + React component flexibility
Laravel PHP Framework Custom web apps, APIs, complex back-end logic Elegant, expressive PHP; excellent for complex business logic and REST APIs
Node.js Back-End JavaScript Real-time applications, APIs, microservices High performance for I/O-bound operations; JavaScript full-stack capability
Python / Django Back-End / Data Data-driven apps, AI integrations, automation Excellent for data processing, ML integrations, and rapid API development
MySQL / PostgreSQL Database Relational data storage for most web applications Battle-tested, ACID-compliant, widely supported
Redis Caching / Sessions Performance caching, session management Sub-millisecond data access; dramatically improves application performance
AWS / Cloudflare Infrastructure / CDN Hosting, CDN, security, DNS UAE data residency options; enterprise-grade reliability; global CDN performance

Our technology decisions are always client-benefit driven. We explain our recommendations in plain language and match the technology to the business problem — not to what happens to be fashionable. When you work with our web design and development team, you get a technology partner who builds for long-term maintainability and scalability.

UAE Web Development Market: Context and Opportunity

Understanding the digital landscape in the UAE is essential context for any web development project. Dubai and the broader UAE are not just emerging markets — they are among the most digitally advanced economies in the world, with government initiatives and private sector investment driving rapid adoption of technology across every sector.

Dubai's Smart City Vision

The Smart Dubai initiative — launched in 2014 and continuously expanded — aims to make Dubai the happiest and smartest city on earth through technology. This has driven widespread digital transformation across government services, retail, hospitality, finance, and healthcare. The Dubai Digital Economy Strategy targets digital economy contributions of 20% of total GDP. For businesses, this means digital presence is not optional — it's a prerequisite for competing in the market.

UAE E-Commerce Growth

The UAE e-commerce market reached approximately USD 5.5 billion in 2023 and is projected to exceed USD 9 billion by 2026, with a compound annual growth rate of over 15%. Mobile commerce accounts for approximately 68% of all e-commerce transactions in the UAE. Dubai alone hosts over 15,000 e-commerce businesses, ranging from solo-operated stores to regional enterprise retailers. Building a robust, fast, and conversion-optimised e-commerce website is one of the highest-ROI investments a UAE retailer can make. Our SEO services help drive organic traffic to these e-commerce properties.

Internet and Mobile Penetration

The UAE has one of the world's highest internet penetration rates at approximately 99% of the population, and smartphone penetration exceeds 97%. Average mobile internet speeds in Dubai regularly exceed 100 Mbps on 5G networks, meaning users have high expectations for website performance — and no patience for slow-loading sites. This makes performance optimisation not just good practice but a commercial necessity.

Tech Talent and Innovation Ecosystem

Dubai's D3 (Dubai Design District), Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Silicon Oasis host thousands of tech companies and tens of thousands of technology professionals. The UAE Golden Visa programme has attracted international tech talent, raising the overall quality and competitiveness of the digital services market. For businesses commissioning web development, this means the quality bar for agency work is high — and choosing an experienced, technically proficient partner matters more than ever.

UAE PDPL and Data Compliance

The UAE Federal Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) came into force in 2022, establishing comprehensive data protection requirements for businesses operating in the UAE. Any website that collects personal data — which includes contact forms, newsletter sign-ups, and e-commerce checkouts — must comply with PDPL requirements including privacy policy disclosure, data subject rights, and appropriate data security measures. Our development practice includes PDPL compliance review as a standard component of every project.

Our Development Standards

Every website and web application we build adheres to a consistent set of technical and quality standards. These aren't optional extras — they're baseline requirements that every project must meet before it goes live.

Security Standards

Web security is a growing concern for UAE businesses of all sizes. Cyberattacks targeting UAE businesses increased by 71% in 2023 according to IBM's X-Force Threat Intelligence Report. Our security standards include:

  • OWASP Top 10 compliance: We test against the industry-standard list of the most critical web application security risks
  • HTTPS everywhere: SSL/TLS certificates installed and enforced across all domains and subdomains
  • SQL injection prevention: Parameterised queries and input sanitisation throughout all database interactions
  • XSS protection: Output encoding and Content Security Policy (CSP) headers configured
  • Authentication hardening: Strong password requirements, rate limiting, and multi-factor authentication where applicable
  • Regular dependency audits: Automated scanning for known vulnerabilities in third-party packages
  • Encrypted data storage: Sensitive data encrypted at rest; PII handled according to UAE PDPL requirements

Performance Standards

Performance directly impacts both user experience and search rankings. Our performance standards align with Google's Core Web Vitals thresholds:

  • Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): Under 2.5 seconds on mobile
  • Interaction to Next Paint (INP): Under 200 milliseconds
  • Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): Under 0.1
  • Google PageSpeed Insights score: 85+ on mobile, 90+ on desktop
  • Image optimisation: WebP format, lazy loading, and appropriate sizing for all images
  • Code minification: CSS, JavaScript, and HTML minified and compressed for all production builds
  • CDN delivery: Static assets served from Cloudflare or AWS CloudFront for global performance

Accessibility and WCAG 2.1

Web accessibility is both a legal consideration and a commercial opportunity. The UAE has approximately 1.4 million people with disabilities, and accessible websites serve this audience while also improving usability for all users. We build to WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards as a baseline:

  • Sufficient colour contrast ratios for all text elements
  • Keyboard navigability throughout all interactive elements
  • Screen reader compatibility with appropriate ARIA labels
  • Alternative text for all informational images
  • Video captions for embedded video content
  • Focus indicators for all interactive elements

Arabic RTL Development Standards

Building truly bilingual Arabic/English websites requires more than CSS direction switching. Our RTL development standards include:

  • Logical CSS properties (margin-inline, padding-inline) for automatic RTL adaptation
  • Font selection and line-height optimised for Arabic typography
  • Icon and image mirroring where directional meaning applies
  • Form field alignment and input direction adjusted for Arabic data entry
  • Bidirectional (BiDi) text handling for mixed Arabic/English content
  • Testing with native Arabic-speaking users before any bilingual site launches

These standards are part of why businesses across Dubai and the wider UAE trust us with complex web development projects. Learn more about our overall approach on our about page.

Common Web Development Mistakes That Damage UAE Businesses

Web development mistakes are often invisible to business owners until they cause a measurable problem — a site goes down, rankings drop, or a security breach exposes customer data. Here are the most costly development mistakes we see in UAE websites.

1. Building on Shared Hosting for Business-Critical Sites

Shared hosting (where your site shares server resources with hundreds of other sites) is appropriate for personal blogs and hobby projects. For a business website handling enquiries, e-commerce transactions, or significant traffic, shared hosting creates performance instability, security exposure (a breach on one site can affect all sites on the server), and unreliable uptime. We recommend managed WordPress hosting (WP Engine, Kinsta, Cloudways) or AWS/DigitalOcean VPS configurations for all business websites.

2. Using Untested or Abandoned Plugins

WordPress's plugin ecosystem is a strength and a vulnerability. There are over 60,000 plugins available — but a significant portion are poorly maintained, incompatible with recent WordPress versions, or outright abandoned. Each plugin is a potential security and performance liability. We audit every plugin in a project against update frequency, active installation count, compatibility, and code quality before including it.

3. Ignoring Database Optimisation

As WordPress sites accumulate content, revisions, and data over years, database performance degrades. Unoptimised databases with thousands of post revisions, orphaned metadata, and unindexed tables are a common cause of slow admin panels and slow front-end queries. We implement database optimisation as part of every build and include it in ongoing maintenance plans.

4. No Staging Environment

Making changes directly to a live website is reckless. A coding error, a plugin conflict, or a failed update can bring a business-critical site offline for hours. Every project we manage has a staging environment (an exact clone of the live site) where all changes are tested before being deployed to production.

5. Inadequate Backup Strategy

We regularly encounter businesses whose websites have never had a successful backup taken. When a site is compromised, infected with malware, or accidentally broken, the ability to restore from a recent clean backup is the difference between a one-hour recovery and days of rebuilding. We configure automated daily backups stored offsite (not on the same server as the website) for every project.

6. Hardcoding Content That Should Be Dynamic

Developers sometimes hardcode content (phone numbers, addresses, prices, team names) directly into theme templates rather than making it manageable through the CMS. This creates situations where a simple update — like changing a phone number — requires developer involvement and deployment. We build content management flexibility into every element that a business might reasonably need to update.

7. Building Without Performance Testing

A website that performs well with 10 simultaneous users may break entirely under 500 concurrent visits — exactly the scenario during a marketing campaign, product launch, or press mention. Load testing before launch identifies and resolves performance bottlenecks before they become business-damaging incidents. This is especially relevant for e-commerce sites running promotional campaigns.

8. No Monitoring After Launch

Websites don't stay healthy on their own. Server resources fill up, plugins develop conflicts, certificates expire, and traffic patterns change. Without monitoring tools (uptime monitoring, error logging, performance tracking), problems go undetected until a customer reports them — often too late. We set up comprehensive monitoring dashboards for every site we build, with alert thresholds that notify us before issues become outages.

Key Takeaways

🔑 What to Remember About Web Development in Dubai

  • The UAE e-commerce market is growing at 15%+ CAGR — a robust technical platform is essential for capitalising on this growth
  • Cyberattacks targeting UAE businesses increased by 71% in 2023 — security must be built in, not added later
  • Core Web Vitals scores directly impact Google rankings — performance is an SEO requirement, not just a UX nice-to-have
  • WordPress powers 43% of all websites globally and remains the most maintainable, flexible CMS for most business projects
  • Genuine RTL Arabic support requires purpose-built development — not just a CSS direction switch
  • UAE PDPL compliance is a legal requirement for any website collecting personal data from UAE residents
  • A staging environment is non-negotiable for any production website — changes should never be made live directly
  • The right technology choice depends on your business requirements — not on what's trendy in developer circles
  • Post-launch monitoring and maintenance prevents the majority of website incidents and security breaches

Frequently Asked Questions: Web Development in Dubai

How long does web development take for a Dubai business website?

Development timelines vary by project complexity. A straightforward business website on WordPress typically takes 3–6 weeks for development once designs are approved. WooCommerce e-commerce stores generally require 6–12 weeks. Custom web applications with complex back-end logic and integrations typically take 12–24 weeks or more. The development timeline runs concurrently with or follows the web design phase, so total project timelines from kick-off to launch are typically 8–24 weeks depending on scope. We provide a detailed timeline in every project proposal.

What CMS options do you recommend for UAE businesses?

WordPress is our primary recommendation for most business websites — it powers 43% of the internet for good reason. It has the most mature ecosystem of plugins, themes, and developer support globally, and it's the platform your team can most easily learn to manage. For e-commerce, WooCommerce (built on WordPress) is our default recommendation, with Shopify considered for simpler product catalogues. For enterprise projects requiring custom content architectures, we sometimes use WordPress as a headless CMS with a Next.js front-end. We recommend against platform builders like Wix and Squarespace for any business serious about SEO and long-term scalability.

Where will my website be hosted?

We recommend and configure managed hosting environments appropriate to the project scale. For most business websites, managed WordPress hosting providers (WP Engine, Kinsta, or Cloudways) offer the best balance of performance, security, and cost. For enterprise projects or applications requiring more control, we configure AWS EC2 or DigitalOcean droplets. All our hosting recommendations include UAE or Middle East data centre options for PDPL compliance and regional performance. We do not lock clients into any specific hosting provider — the hosting account is always in the client's name.

How do you handle website security?

Security is integrated throughout our development process. We follow OWASP Top 10 security guidelines, implement SSL certificates, configure Web Application Firewalls, set up automated malware scanning, harden file permissions, implement strong authentication controls, and conduct security testing before every launch. For WordPress specifically, we lock down admin access, disable file editing, and configure a comprehensive security plugin suite. We also include security monitoring in our ongoing maintenance plans, as threats evolve continuously.

Can you integrate my website with third-party systems?

Yes — API and third-party integration is a core part of our development capability. We regularly integrate websites with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM), email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign), payment gateways (Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay), ERP systems, inventory management platforms, booking systems, WhatsApp Business API, and custom REST APIs. We document all integrations thoroughly so your team understands the data flows and dependencies.

Do you build websites that support Arabic and English?

Yes. Bilingual Arabic/English development is a specialisation of ours. True Arabic RTL support goes beyond CSS — it requires rethinking layout logic, typography, form behaviour, and icon direction for the right-to-left reading context. We build bilingual sites using WordPress's multilingual plugins (WPML or Polylang) with proper language switching, hreflang tags for SEO, and native RTL CSS using logical properties. We test with native Arabic speakers before launch.

What happens if my website breaks after launch?

All clients on our monthly maintenance plans have priority support response times — typically same-day or next-business-day for non-critical issues, and within 2 hours for site-down emergencies. We maintain recent backups for rapid restoration. For clients not on a maintenance plan, we provide paid emergency support. We recommend all business websites have some form of ongoing support arrangement, as unmonitored WordPress sites can develop issues over time through plugin conflicts, WordPress updates, or security events.

Can you take over maintenance of a website someone else built?

Yes — we regularly take on maintenance and development of websites built by previous agencies or freelancers. We conduct a full technical audit first to assess the current state of the codebase, security, performance, and technical debt. We'll be honest about what we find: sometimes a site can be maintained effectively; other times a rebuild is the more cost-effective long-term solution. The audit cost is credited against any subsequent project.

How do you approach accessibility and WCAG compliance?

We build to WCAG 2.1 Level AA as a baseline standard for all projects. This includes sufficient colour contrast, keyboard navigability, screen reader compatibility (ARIA labels), alternative text for images, and focus indicators. For government tenders and large enterprise clients, we can provide accessibility audit reports and remediation documentation. Accessibility also improves SEO — accessible HTML is semantically correct HTML, which search engines read more effectively.

Will my website perform well on Google Core Web Vitals?

Yes — we target 85+ on Google PageSpeed Insights mobile score for every project. This requires performance-conscious development from the start: optimised images (WebP format, appropriate sizing, lazy loading), minimised CSS and JavaScript, efficient font loading, CDN delivery for static assets, and server-side caching. We verify Core Web Vitals compliance in both lab and field data before launch. Strong Core Web Vitals scores contribute to SEO performance and provide a better experience for the 78% of UAE users on mobile devices.

Do you offer e-commerce development for UAE businesses?

Yes. We build WooCommerce stores integrated with UAE payment gateways (Stripe, PayTabs, Telr, HyperPay, Amazon Payment Services), UAE shipping providers, and where required, UAE customs and VAT calculation systems. We also handle complex product configurations — variable products, subscriptions, bundles, and digital downloads. For UAE e-commerce businesses, we pay particular attention to mobile checkout flow, as approximately 68% of UAE e-commerce transactions are completed on mobile devices. Learn more about our PPC management services to drive paid traffic to your e-commerce store.

What is your development quality assurance process?

Every project goes through a structured QA process before launch: cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge), cross-device testing (iOS and Android, multiple screen sizes), functionality testing of all forms and interactive elements, performance testing, security scanning, accessibility checking, and SEO technical review. We maintain a comprehensive pre-launch checklist with over 60 checkpoints that every project must pass. We also conduct load testing for e-commerce sites and any project expecting significant traffic volumes.

Can you build a custom web application — not just a website?

Yes. In addition to websites, we build custom web applications: SaaS products, client portals, booking and reservation systems, directory and marketplace platforms, membership sites, and internal business tools. These projects typically use our Laravel or Node.js back-end stack with a React or Next.js front-end. We follow agile development methodology with regular sprint reviews so clients see and provide feedback on progress throughout the build — not just at the end.

Do you provide the source code and documentation?

Absolutely. All source code for client projects is owned by the client. We deliver projects via a version-controlled Git repository (GitHub or Bitbucket), with comprehensive technical documentation covering the system architecture, deployment procedures, third-party integrations, and CMS usage. We never retain ownership of client code or create proprietary dependencies that lock clients into working with us. Our goal is to build your capability and independence, not dependency.

How do you handle website updates and WordPress version upgrades?

WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates are the most common source of website issues if not managed carefully. Major WordPress updates occasionally introduce breaking changes that require developer attention. Our maintenance service manages all updates on a staging environment first, verifies compatibility and functionality, then deploys to live — never updating production directly. We also monitor the WordPress security team's disclosures and apply security patches as a priority outside the normal update schedule when critical vulnerabilities are announced.

How do I start a web development project with you?

Start with a free discovery call where we discuss your project requirements, technical constraints, integration needs, and timeline. We'll ask the right questions to fully scope the project. Following the call, we provide a detailed proposal with a fixed price, timeline, and deliverables specification. There are no hidden costs and no ongoing retainer obligations beyond the agreed project scope. Book your free consultation here. You can also explore our full range of digital services or read our blog for technical insights into web development best practices.

Related Services

Excellent web development creates the technical foundation — but the full return on investment comes from integrating development with strategy, design, and ongoing digital marketing.

  • Web Design — Bespoke visual design that converts visitors into customers, built for the UAE market
  • SEO Services — Technical SEO, content strategy, and link building to rank your new website on Google
  • AI Search Optimisation — Structure your content to appear in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT answers
  • PPC Management — Google Ads campaigns that drive immediate traffic while organic rankings build
  • Social Media Marketing — Extend your digital presence across the platforms your UAE audience uses daily

Need a Technical Partner for Your Web Project?

Whether you're building from scratch, need to rescue an underperforming site, or want to develop a custom web application, we have the technical depth to deliver it. Book a free technical consultation — no sales pressure, just expert advice.

Get a Free Technical Consultation View Case Studies

Explore our work in Dubai and across the UAE, read expert development insights on our blog, or learn more about our team on the about page. We're also available to discuss your project directly — just get in touch.
